440: Bismala, lokovel libba. lulav bimina, kappot becholla, vekatir becholla. deha tzaddik kappot hu bechol sitrin, vekatir becholla, veda hu kishshura dimhemnuta.

Uvesifra deaggadta shappir kaamar, dechol illen inun ushepizin, dezamminin amma kaddisha behay yoma, devayayn leashkacha lehu, kevan dezammin lon. uvehu bae bar nash lemalka bauteh. zakkain inun yisrael deyadin archoy demalka kaddisha, veyadin archoy deorayyta, lemehach beorach keshot, lemizke behu bealma den uvealma deate.

Beyoma da nafke yisrael, besimanin reshimin miggo malka, begin deinun natzchin dina. umay simanin inun, simane mehemnuta, chotama demalka illaa. litre beni nasha, dealu kodam malka ledina, vela yade alma man minnayyhu natzach. nafak chad ligyon mibbe malka, sheilu lo. amar lon, man deyippuk uvidoy simanin demalka, hu natzach.

Kacha, kule alma alin ledina, kodam malka illaa, vedain lon miyyoma derosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, ad chamesh sare yomin leyarcha. uven kach ishtakkachu yisrael zakkain kullehu bityuveta. tarchin besukka velulav veetrog, vela yade man natzach dina. malache illae shaalu man natzach dina. kudesha berich hu amar lehu, inun demafke bidayyhu simanin dili, inun natzchin dina.

Behay yoma, nafke yisrael birshimu demalka, betushebachta dehallela. alin bassukka, etrog bismala, lulav bimina. chaman kullehu, deyisrael reshimin birshimin demalka kaddisha. patche veamre, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam she elohav.

Ad kan chedvavta decholla, chedvavta deushepizin, veafillu ummot haolam chadan bechedvavta, umitbarchin minnah. veal da (makrivin) karbanin bechol yoma alayyhu, laatala alayyhu shelam, veyitbarchun minan. mikkan ulehala, yoma chad, demalka illaa, dechade behu beyisrael. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 29:35) bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem. deha yoma da min malka bilchodoy, chedvavta dileh beyisrael. lemalka dezammin ushepizin vechulei.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:1) ani chavatztzelet hashsharon shoshannat haamakim, kamma chaviva keneset yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, dekudesha berich hu meshabbach lah, vehi meshabbachat leh tadir, vechamma meshabbechin umezammerin azminat leh tadir lekudesha berich hu. zakkaa chulekehon deyisrael, deachidan beh beadva dechulaka kaddisha. kema dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo vegomer.
Ani chavatztzelet hashsharon, da keneset yisrael, dekayyma beshappiru denoy beginta deeden. hashsharon, dehi shara umeshabbachat lemalka illaa.

Davar acher ani chavatztzelet hashsharon, devaya leashkaa mishshakyu denachala amika, mabbua denachalin. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 35:7) vehaya hashsharav leaggam. (nusach acher 1 vehaya hashsharon chaareva) shoshannat haamakim, dekayyma baamikta decholla. man inun amakim. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 130:1) mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai. chavatztzelet hashsharon. chavatztzelet, mehahu atar, deshakyu denachalin nafkin vela paskin lealmin. shoshannat haamakim, shoshanna mehahu atar deikre amika decholla, satim mikkol sitrin.

Ta chaze, bekadmita yeruka kachavatztzelet, detarpin dilah yerukin. levatar shoshannat, sumeka bigvavnin chivvrin. shoshanna beshit tarpin, shoshannat, deishteniat miggoona legoona, veshanniat gevavnaha.

Shoshannat, bekadmita chavatztzelet, beiddana devaya leizdavvavga beh bemalka, ikre chavatztzelet. batar deitdabbekat beh bemalka beinun neshikin, ikre soshannat. begin dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) siftotav shoshannim. shoshannat haamakim dehi meshanyay gevavnaha, zimnin letav, vezimnin levish, zimnin lerachame, zimna ledina.

(Bereshit 3:6) vattere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachol vechi taava hu laenayim. ta chaze, deha bene nasha la mistakkelin, vela yadin, vela mashgichin. beshata devara kudesha berich hu leadam, veokir leh bikiru illaa, baa minneh leitdabbeka beh begin deyishtakkach yechiday, uvelibba yechiday, uvaatar didvekuta yechiday, dela
441: Ishtanne, vela mithappech lealmin. behahu kishshura yechida, decholla beh itkashshar. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:9) veetz hachayyim betoch haggan.

Levatar satu mearcha dimhemnuta, veshavku ilana yechiday, illaa mikkol ilanin. veatu leitdabbeka beatar demishtanne, umithappech miggoona legoona umittav levish umibbish letav. venachate meela letatta, veitdabbaku letatta beshinnuyin saggiin. veshavku ilana yechidaa, illaa mikkol ilanin. hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:29) asher asa haelohim et haadam yashar vegomer.

Vadday keden ithappach libbayyhu, behahu sitra mammash, zimnin letav, zimnin levish, zimnin lerachame, zimnin ledina. behay milla deitdabbaku bah vadday, (Kohelet 7:29) vikshu chishvonot rabbim, veitdabbaku behu.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, adam, shevakt chayye veitdabbakt bemota. chayye, dichtiv veetz hachayyim betoch haggan, deikre chayyim. deman deachid beh, la taim mota lealmin. itdabbakt beilana ochora, ha vadday mota hu lekivlach. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavet, uchetiv, (Kohelet 7:26) umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha. vadday beatar demota itdabbak, veshavak atar dechayye. begin kach itgezar aleh veal kol alma mota.

I hu chata, kol alma ma chatu. i tema, dechol alma achle meilana da, veitramme lecholla. lav hachi. ella beshata deadam kaim al ragloy, chame leh biryayn kullehu, udechilu mikkammeh, vehavu natlin avatreh, keavdin batar malka. vehu amar lon, ana veattun, (Tehillim 95:6) bou nishtachave venichraa vegomer. veazlu kullehu avatreh. kevan dechazu deadam segid lehay atar, veitdabbak beh, kullehu itmashshechu avatreh vegarim mota lechol alma.

Ucheden ishtanne adam lechamma gevavnin, zimnin dina, zimnin rachame zimnin mota, zimnin chayye. vela kaim bekiyyuma tadir bechad minnayyhu, begin dehahu atar garim leh. veal da ikre, cherev hammithappechet, hammithappechet missitra da lesitra da, mittav levish, merachame ledina, mishshelam lekarava, mithappechet hi becholla. tav vera dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:9) veetz haddaat tov vara.

Umalka illaa, lerachama al ovadoy, ochach leh, veamar leh, umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu vegomer, vehu la kabbil minneh, veitmeshach batar itteteh, veittarach lealmin. deha itteta leatra (sefer acher laatar da) salka vela yattir, veitteta garim mota lecholla.

Ta chaze, lealma deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 65:22) ki kime haetz yeme ammi, kime haetz, hahu deishtemodaa, beh zimna, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz vegomer (74 kan nidpas bevayyikra):

Vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut. tana, amar ribbi chiyyay, ketiv vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana, hatam bekiyyumeh yaakov, vehacha bemitateh yisrael. dichtiv, vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut. amar ribbi yose, hachi hu vadday, deha la ketiv vayyikrav yom yisrael lamut, ella yeme, vechi bechamma yome mit bar nash, veha beshata chada, beriga chada, mit venafik mealma.

Ella hachi tana, kad kudesha berich hu bae leatava rucheh leh, kol inun yomin dekaim bar nash behay alma, itpakdan kammeh, vealin bechushebna. vechad itkerivu kammeh lemeal bechushebna, mit bar nash. veativ kudesha berich hu rucheh leh, hahu hevel deappik venafach beh, otveh legabbeh.

Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, deyomoy itkerivu gabbe malka bela kissufa, vela dache yoma minnayyhu levar, deyishkach behahu yoma, deitavid beh chova. begin kach, ketiv betzaddikaya, keriva. (vehech yikrevun) mishshum dekarivu yomoy kamme malka, bela kissufa.

Vavy lerashshiaya, dela ketiv behu keriva, vehech yikrevun yome kamme malka, deha kol yomoy bechove alma ishtakkachu. vvgine kach la yikrevun kamme malka, vela yitmannun kammeh, vela yiddachru leela, ella inun shetzean miggavvavyyhu. alayyhu ketiv, (Mishlei 4:19) derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu.
442: Vehacha vayyikrevu yeme yisrael vadday, bela chissufa, bishlemuta, bechedvavta shelim. uvegine kach, yeme yisrael, dehava shelim yattir yisrael miyyaakov. vei tema, veha ketiv, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam, shelim. shelim hava, vela shelim bedarga illaa keyisrael.

Tanya, amar ribbi yose, beshata deyomoy devar nash itpakkidan kame malka, it zakkaa deitpakkedan yomoy urechikin mikkamme malka. veit zakkaa, dechad mitpakkedan yomoy, kerivin usemichin lemalka, vela mitrachakin. bela chissufa alin, vekarivin lemalka. zakkaa chulekehon. hada hu dichtiv, vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut.

Vayyikra livno leyosef, amar ribbi yitzchak, vechi shear shivtin lav benoy inun. ella amar ribbi abba, yosef beno hava yattir mikkullehu. detaninan, beshata deinteteh defotifar dechakat leh leyosef, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 39:11) vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto veen ish meanshe habbayit. hay kera hachi mibbae leh, veen ish babbayit. mahu meanshe habbayit. ella leachlala diukena deyaakov, dehava tamman veishtakkach tamman. uvegine kach meanshe habbayit, aval ish ochora hava tamman. kevan desalik yosef enoy, vechama diukena daavoy, yetiv bekiyyumeh, vetav laachora.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 39:8) vaymaen vayyomer el eshet adonav. amar leh kudesha berich hu, at amart vaymaen, vayyomer. chayyecha, vaymaen vayyomer ochora, yete levarcha livnach, veyitbarchun beh. hada hu dichtiv, vaymaen aviv vayyomer yadati beni yadati.

Kevan deamar yadati beni, ammay amar, yadati ochora. ella amar, yadati beni, bezimna dekayymat begufach deat bari, kad chamit diukena dili, vetavat bekiyyumach. uvegine kach ketiv, yadati beni, yadati. al ma deamart deda hu buchera, gam hu yihye leam vegam hu yigdal, vehacha begin kach ketiv, vayyikra livno leyosef, livno leyosef mammash.

Davar acher, vayyikra livno leyosef, devdiukena chad havu mitchazzeyayn. dechol man dechame leyosef, hava ashid divreh deyaakov hava. ribbi yose amar, kolla hachi hu. veod deyosef zan leh velivnoy besivuteh, uvegine kach beno mammash, yattir mikkullehu. vayyikra livno leyosef, ammay leyosef vela leochora. mishshum dirshuta hava bideh lesalkeh mittamman.

Ribbi yose amar, kevan deyaakov hava yada divnoy yishtabedun begaluta tamman bemitzrayim, ammay la itkabbar tamman begin deyagin zechuteh al benoy. ammay baa leistalleka mittamman. veha ketiv, (Tehillim 103:13) kerachem av al banim, an hu rachmanuta.

Ella hachi tana, beshata dehava nachit yaakov lemitzrayim, hava dachil. hava amar, dilma chas veshalom yishtetzun banay beni ammemaya, vedilma kudesha berich hu yesallek shechinteh mini kekadmita. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 35:9) vayyera elohim el yaakov vegomer. (Bereshit 46:3) (vayyomer elohim leyisrael) al tira merda mitzrayma ki legoy gadol asimcha sham. uma deamart dilma asallek shechinatti mibbenach, anochi ered immecha mitzrayma.
Amar od, dachilna dilma itkabbar tamman, vela ezke im avahatay. amar leh veanochi aalcha gam alo. aalcha, mimmitzrayim. gam alo, leitkabberaa bekivra daavahatach.

Begine kach, baa lesalka garmeh mimitzrayim. chad, dela yaavdun minneh dachala, deha chama dekudesha berich hu zammin leitperaa middachalehon. vechad, dechama dishchinta yeshavve medoreh ben benoy begaluta. vechad, begin dihe gufeh dayyayr ben gufayyhu daavahatoy leitkelala benayyhu, vela yitmanne im chayyayvaya demitzrae.

Vetaninan, gufa deyaakov, itmeshich mishshuferoy deadam harishon, vehava diukenih deyaakov, diukena illaa kaddisha. diukena dechuresya kaddisha, vela baa leitkevara beni chayyayvaya. veraza demilla, devaavahan let piruda kelal. veal da ketiv v shachavti im avotay.

Vayyikra livno leyosef, beno, bechad diukena deanpin, begin deviruta derucha velibba, olid leh yattir mikkullehu. ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 30:15) hameat kachtech et ishi, dechol reuta deyaakov berachel hava, uvegin kach
443: Tana, ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Devarim 29:28) hannistarot laAdonai elokenu vegomer. hannistarot laAdonai elokenu, ta chaze, kamma it leh levar nash leizdahara mechovoy, uleistakkala dela yaavar al reuteh demareh. detaninan, kol ma devar nash avid behay alma, besifra ketivu inun ovadin, vealin bechushebna kame malka kaddisha, vecholla itgalleyay kammeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai. i hachi, ech la yistammar bar nash millemechav kammeh demareh. vetaninan, afillu hahu (man) ma dechashiv bar nash veistallak biruteh, kolla ishtakkach kame kudesha berich hu, vela itavid minneh.

Ta chaze, behahu lelya dealat lea legabbeh deyaakov, veyahavat leh inun simanin deyahav yaakov lerachel, salik biruteh deihi rachel, veshammash shimmusha bah. vehahi tippa kadmita deyaakov havat. dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:3) kochi vereshit oni, vesavar deihi rachel. kudesha berich hu deihu gale amikta umesattarta, veyada ma bachashocha, salik hahu reuta leatreh, uvecheruta diruven istallak leyosef. may tama, mishshum deha derachel havat, hahi tippa kadmita denafkat miyyaakov. uvegin dehavat dilah, hahu becheruta mammash diruven, yarit yosef. verachel yarta lehahu dilah.

Uvegin kach, raza demilla, la istallak reuven bishma kishar shivtin. ella reuven. kelomar chamu bar, reu ben setam. vehay ben la ityeda shemeh, veal da la karya lea bene behay shema, vela ikre reu beni, deha lea yadat ovada.

Vetaninan, gale kamme kudesha berich hu, deyaakov lav reuteh lemechav kammeh behay, vela istakkal biruta beitteta ochora behahi shata, kishar chayyayve alma. veal kach ketiv, (Bereshit 35:22-23) vayyihyu bene yaakov shenem asar. deha benayyhu dishar chayyayve alma deavdin hahu ovada, bishma ochora ikrun. veha yedia milla da legabbe chavraya, uvegine kach vayyikra livno leyosef, beno mammash, mishsheruta vesiyyuma (davar acher 33 bereh) beno hava.

Tana, amar ribbi yose, bamme ome leh yaakov leyosef, dichtiv sim na yadcha tachat yerechi. ella behahu at kayyayma, dehava rashim bevisreh, deda chashivuta deavahan yattir mikkolla. vehay berit, raza deyosef ihu.

Amar rabbi shimon, beavraham uveyaakov ketiv, sim na yadcha tachat yerechi, techot yurichi, kelomar, behahu atar dirmiza bishma kaddisha, veappik zara kaddisha mehemna lealma. beyitzchak lo ketiv, begin denafik minneh esav.

Tu, may tama hacha, sim na yadcha tachat yerechi al na tikbereni bemitzrayim. ella amar leh yaakov leyosef, behay reshima kaddisha ome li, deappik zara kaddisha mehemna lealma, veitnetir, vela istaav lealmin. dela yitkabbar ben inun mesaavin, dela natru leh lealmin. dichtiv behu, (Yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram vezirmat susim zirmatam.

Vei tema, ha yosef denatir leh al kolla, ammay itkabbar benayyhu. ella taninan, ketiv, (Yechezkel 1:3) hayo haya devar Adonai el yechezkel ben buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim al nehar kevar, veha taninan, dishchinta la sharya ella beara deyisrael. ammay hacha shechinta. ella al nehar kevar ketiv, uchetiv vattehi alav sham yad Adonai. uf hacha, yosef bemaya itrame arona dileh. amar kudesha berich hu, i yosef istallak mehacha, galuta la itkeyyaym. ella tehe kevureteh beatar dela yistaav, veyisbelun bene yisrael galuta.

Tana, amar ribbi yose, chama yaakov deha becholla ittakkan lecharseya kaddisha baavahan (kaabahen). amar, i hachi yitkabbar, hech gufa da achida baavahata, veafillu mearta deitkkabbar tamman ikre chafelta. begin dechol milla dechafelta hu teren vechad, uf mearta teren vechad.
Veta chaze, avhata zachu leitkabbera tamman, inun veziuugayyhu. yaakov
444: Hu velea, may tama rachel la, veha ketiv, (Bereshit 29:31) verachel akara, deihi ikkara deveta. ella, lea zachta beh, leafaka shit shivtin miggiza kaddisha bealma yattir. uvegine kach, ityayhavat immeh leziuuga bimarta.

Amar ribbi yehuda lea kol yomaha, havat befarashat orchin kayyayma, uvachat begineh deyaakov, kad shamat deihu tzaddika. utzelota akdamat leh. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:17) veene lea rakkot, kema deokimna, demakdamat veyatvat befarashat orchin lemishal.

Rachel la nafkat leorchin lealma. begine kach zachta lea leitkabbera immeh. verachel kayyemet kevuratah befarashat orchin veitkevarat tamman. hada hu dichtiv, vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel. mahu alay. alay vadday, kelomar begini. beeretz kenaan badderech, begini mitat badderech, dela nafkat begini lealmin kaachatah.

Vegin kach, lea denafkat uvachat befarashat orchin begineh deyaakov, zachta leitkevara immeh. rachel dela baat lemefak ulemishal bahadeh, vegin kach kevurata befarashat orchin. veraza demilla, ha okimna veittemar, da beitgalya, veda beitkasseya.

Veta chaze, detanya, dimin saggiin shadiat hahi tzaddeket lea, begin lemeheve chulakeh deyaakov, vela behahu rasha deesav. vehayeynu detaninan, kol bar nash deoshid dimin kammeh dekudesha berich hu, af al gav deitgezar aleh onasha, yitkara, vela yachil hahu onasha leshalletaa beh. menalan, millea, deha lea itgezar lemeheve chulaka deesav, vehi bevauta akdimat leh leyaakov, vela ityeyhivat leh leesav.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, veshachavti im avotay vegomer. ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Kohelet 1:3) ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh. bechamma atar ittemar deistakkalna bemilloy dishlomo veitchaze milloy setimin, aval kullehu mille dishlomo, kullehu ikrun bechachmata.

Detanya ketiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo, beyomoy dishlomo malka, kayyma sihara beashlamuta. vehayeynu dichtiv, vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kol bene kedem. tamman taninan, man inun beni kedem, ha ukemuha. aval chachmat bene kedem, hi chachmeta deyartu meavraham.

Detanya ketiv, (Bereshit 25:5) vayyitten avraham et kol asher lo leyitzchak. may et kol asher lo. da chachmeta illaa dehava yada bishma kaddisha dekudesha berich hu, umashma et kol asher lo, dehava dileh. kidtaninan behahi bat dehavat leh leavraham, uvakkol shemah.

Velivne happillagshim asher leavraham natan avraham mattanot vegomer. deyahav lehu milin yedian, bechitrin tattain, uvean atar ashre lon, el eretz kedem. umittamman yaritu beni kedem chachmata, vehayeynu dichtiv mechachmat kol bene kedem.

Tana, yoma chad hava ate ribbi shimon mikkappotkiyya lelod, vehava immeh ribbi abba veribbi yehuda. ribbi abba hava lae, vehava rahit avatreh deribbi shimon dehava rachiv. amar ribbi abba, vadday (Hoshea 11:10) achare Adonai yelechu kearye yishag.

Nachat ribbi shimon, amar leh, vadday ketiv, (Devarim 9:9) vaeshev bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla, vadday chachmeta la mityayshva, ella kad bar nash yativ vela azil, ella kaim bekiyyumeh. veha okimna mille al ma ketiv vaeshev. hasheta benayycha talyay milta. yatvu.

Amar ribbi abba, ketiv vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kol bene kedem umikkol chachmat mitzrayim. may hi chachmat shelomo umay hi chachmat mitzrayim umay hi chachmat kol beni kedem. amar leh, ta chaze, bechamma atar ukemuha behahu shema, desihara kad itbarcha mikkolla, ketiv vatterev. beyomoy dishlomo, deitreviat veitbarchat vekayyma beashlamuta.
Vetaninan, elef turin mitravrevin kammah, vechullehu neshiva chad havu lekammah. elef naharin saggiin lah, uvigmia chada gama lon.
445: Yedaha achidan learba veesrin (vechamesh) elef evar, let denafik minnah listar hay, velet denafik minnah listar ochora. kamma vechamma elef teresin, mitachadin besaaraha.

Chad ulema, deorkeh meresha dealma lisyayfe dealma, nafik ben raglaha. beshittin pulese denura mitlabbesh, begavvne da itmana al tattae (mittechot) mearba sitraha. da ihu naar, deachid shit mea utelat asar maftechan illain missitra deimma. vechullehu maftechan illain, beshinnena decharba dachagir bechartzeh talyayn.

Hahu naar, karun leh chanoch ben yered, beinun beriyyayte, dichtiv, (Mishlei 22:6) chanoch lannaar al pi darko. vei tema matnitin hi, vela berayyeyta. bematnitta dilan okimna mile, veha ittemar, vecholla milleta chada istakkalu (nusach acher ishtachlelu). techoteh titlal chevat bera. detanya (nusach acher data chaze), kema deyisrael kaddisha illaa, ikre ben leimmeh, dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:3) ki ben hayiti leavi rach veyachid lifne immi, uchetiv, (shamevated) beni bechori yisrael, hachi name letatta, da ikre naar leimmeh. dichtiv, (Hoshea 11:1) ki naar yisrael vaohavehu, uvechamma gevavnin ikre ben yared, veha okimna. aval ta chaze, ben yered mammash. detaninan, eser yeridot yarda shechina leara, vechullehu ukemuha chavrayyay veittemar. utechot hay, kamma chevata kayymin, deikrun chevat bera mammash.

Techot inun chevavta, mitachadan saaraha desihara, deikrun kochvaya desharvita, desharvit mammash, mare demarin, mare dematkela, mare dekashyu, mare dechutzepa. vechullehu ikrun mare (nusach acher shaare) deargevavna, yedaha veraglaha achidan behay, kearye (kaddisha) takkifa deachid al tarpeh. veal da ketiv, (Micha Adonai:7) vetaraf veen matztzil.

Tuferaha, kol inun deadkerin chove bene nasha, vechatvin verashmin chovayyhu bitkifu dedina kashya. veal da ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:1) chattat yehuda ketuva beet barzel betzipporen shamir. mahu shamir. hahu derashim venakiv avna, ufasik lah lechol sitra.
Zuhama detofraha, kol inun dela mitdabbekin begufa demalka, veyankin missitra dimsaavuta, kad share sihara bifgimu.
Uvegin dishlomo malka yarta lesihara bishlemuta, bae leyarta lah bifgimuta, veal da ishtaddal lemeda, bedata (biruta) deruchin veshedin, lemerat sihara bechol sitra.

Uveyomoy dishlomo malka, becholla itnehir sihara. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo, vatterev dayyka. mechachmat kol beni kedem, raza illaa hu, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hamelachim asher malchu beeretz edom vegomer. veillen ikrun beni kedem, dechullehu la itkayymu, bar mehay dichlila dechar venukeva deikre hadar. dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:39) vayyimloch tachtav hadar vegomer.
Vetana, deaf al gav deitkayymat (nusach acher daatanehayrat sihara), la itnehirat beashlamuta. ad deata shelomo, deitchaze lekivlaha, kema deokimna. divgin kach immeh bat sheva havat.

Umikkol chachmat mitzrayim, da chachma tattaa, deikre shifcha devatar rechaya, vecholla itkelilat hay chachma dishlomo, chachmat beni kedem, vechachmat mitzrayim. amar ribbi abba, berich rachamana, deshailna kammach milla da, deha bechol hanne mile (milla da) zachina. amar ribbi shimon, millin illen, ha okimna lon, veha ittamru.

Tana, (Kohelet 1:3) ma yitron leadam bechol amalo, yachol af amala deorayyta, talmud lomar sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh (ketiv). shane amala deorayyta, dilela min shimsha hu. ribbi chiyyay amar, af amala deorayyta, deihu amal beginehon divne nasha, o begin yekara dileh. hay tachat hashshemesh ketiv. deha la salik leela. tanya amar ribbi elazar, afillu i bar nash kayyaym elef shenin, hahu yoma deistallak mealma, dame leh keillu la itkeyyaym bar yoma chad:

Veshachavti im avotay, zakkaa chulekehon daavahata, dekudesha berich hu avid lon reticha kaddisha leela, veitree behu, leitattera immehon. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 10:15) rak baavotecha chashak Adonai vegomer. amar ribbi
446: Elazar, yaakov hava yada, deha ittura dileh baavahateh hu, deha ittura daavahan immeh hu, vehu immehon. veal da beatvavn gelifin taninan, 300 telat kishrin, teren kishrin, chad mehay sitra, vechad mehay sitra, vechad dechalil lon. veda hu detaninan, (Shemot 26:28-29) vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze, vehahu kishra divemtzaita, achid lehay sitra, ulehay sitra. veal hay ketiv, veshachavti im avotay vadday.

Veshachavti im avotay vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 42:18) hachershim shemau vehaivrim habbitu lirot. hachershim shemau, illen bene nasha dela tzayytin lemillule orayyta, vela pakchin udenayyhu, lemishma lefikkude demarehon. vehaivrim, dela mistakkelin leminda al ma inun kayymin. deha bechol yoma veyoma karoza nafik vekare, velet man deyashgach.

Detanya, inun yomin debar nash kad itbere, behahu yoma denafak lealma, kullehu kayymin bekiyyumayyhu. veazlin vetasin bealma, nachatin veazharan lebar nash, kol yoma veyoma bilchodoy. vechad hahu yoma ate veazhar leh, uvar nash avid behahu yoma chova kamme mareh. hahu yoma salik bechissufa, veashid sahaduta, vekaim bilchodoy levar.

Vetana, batar dekaim bilchodoy, yativ, ad devar nash avid minneh teshuva. zacha, tav hahu yoma leatreh. la zacha, hahu yoma nachit, veishtattaf behahu rucha dilvar, vetav leveteh. veittakkan bediukeneh dehahu bar nash mammash, begin leavasha leh, vedayyayr immeh beveta. veit dediyyura letav i hu zache. vei lav, diyyureh immeh levish.

Ben kach uven kach, itpakdan inun yomin vechaserim, vela alin beminyayna deinun deishtaaru. vavy lehahu bar nash, degara yomoy kamme malka kaddisha, vela shavik leela yomin, leitattera behu behahu alma, uleitkarva bahadayyhu kamme malka kaddisha.

Ta chaze, kad kerivu inun yomin kamme malka kaddisha. i hu zakkaa, hay bar nash denafik mealma, salik veal beinun yomin. veinun levushe yekar, demitlabbesha beh nishmateh. veinun yomin havu, dezacha behu, vela chav behu.

Vavy lehahu degara yomoy leela. dechad baan lealbasha leh beyomoy, inun yomin defagim ihu bechovoy, chasrin mehahu levusha, veitlabbash bemana chasera. kol sheken i saggiin inun, vela lehve leh lebar nash bamme deitlabbash behahu alma. keden vavy leh, vavy lenafsheh, dedayynin leh baggehinnam al inun yomin. yomin al yomin, yomin al chad terin. dechad nafik mehay alma, la ashkach yomin deitlabbash behu, vela have leh levusha bame deitkasse. zakkain inun tzaddikaya, deyomehon kullehon temirin inun legabbeh demalka kaddisha, veitavid minnayyhu levushe yekar, leitlabbesha behu bealma deate.

Taninan beraza dematnitin, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:7) vayyedu ki erummim hem, yedia yade mammash. dehahu levusha dikar, deitavid meinun yomin, gara minnayyhu, vela ishtaar yoma meinun yomin leitlabbesha beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:16) galmi rau enycha veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu. yamim yutzaru. yamim yutzaru vadday, velo echad bahem, deha la ishtaar chad minnayyhu leitlabbesha behu. ad deishtaddal adam, veavad teshuva, vekudesha berich hu kabbil leh, veavid leh mana (mane) levusha ochoranin, vela min yomoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:21) vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem.

Ta chaze, beavraham dezacha, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 24) ba bayyamim, mishshum dezacha. kad istallak mehay alma, beinun yomin mammash dileh, al veitlabbash behu, vela gara mehahu levush yekar kelum, dichtiv ba bayyamim. beiyyov ma ketiv, (Iyov 1:21) vayyomer arom yatzati mibbeten immi vearom ashuv shamma. deha la ishtaar levusha leitlabbesha beh.
Tana, zakkain inun tzaddikaya, deyomehon zakkain, veishtaaru lealma deate (zakkain), vechad nafkin, mitchabberan kullehu, veitavidu
447: Levushe yekar, leitlabbesha beh. uvehahu levusha, zachan leitannaga meinnuga dealma deate, uvehahu levusha, zeminin laachayay ulemekam. vechol inun deit lehu levusha yekumun, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:14) vayyityatztzevu kemo levush. vavy leinun chayyayve alma, deyomehon bechovehon (almin) chasrin, vela ishtaar minnayyhu, bamme deitkasyayn, kad yifkun mealma.

Tana, kol inun zakkain, dezachu leitlabbesha bilvush yekar beyomehon, mitatteran behahu alma (sefer acher golma), meitture demitattere behu avahan, mehahu nachal denagid venafik leginta deeden. hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya moach) venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha vegomer. veinun chayyayve alma, dela zachu leitlabbesha bilvusha deyomehon, alayyhu ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:6) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov veshachan charerim bammidbar.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov, derachatzanu yattir hava leh, dichtiv veshachavti im avotay. deezke behu vela beochora. deezke behu, leitlabbesha beyomin dileh, uveyomin dilhon.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ketiv, (Bereshit 27:27) vayarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu. begadav. bigde esav mibbae leh. deha lav dideh havu, ella deesav havu hanehu begadim. dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:15) vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot, bigde esav ketiv (hacha), vehacha reach begadav, deyaakov mashma.

Ella, hachi okimna, vayyarach, kelomar, istakkal lehala, vearach recha dilvushoy dehahu alma, keden barcheh. veal da ketiv, ree reach beni kereach sade, da hu chakal detappuchin kaddishin. amar, hoil vezachita beinun levushe yekar, veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim. may mashma, begin divhahu chakal detappuchin kaddishin, natil (sefer acher natif) talla kol yoma, mehahu atar deikre shamayim, dichtiv mittal hashshamayim.

Amar ribbi yose, becholla barcheh, mittal hashshamayim umishmanni haaretz. may tama, begin devayyarach et reach begadav. begadav mammash, kema deokimna. tana, elef vachamash mea rechin, salkin bechol yoma miggan eden, demitbasseme behu inun levushin dikar dehahu alma, demitatteran min yomoy devar nash.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kamma levushin inun. amar ribbi elazar, ture (Vayikra amud alef amud bet) dealma, al da peligu. aval telata inun. chad demitlabbeshe behahu levusha, rucha divginta deeden deara. vechad yekara mikkolla, demitlabbesha beh nishmata bego tzerora dechayye, ben purepira demalka. vechad levusha dilvar, dekaim vela kaim, itchaze vela itchaze. behay mitlabbesha beh nafsha, veazla veshata bealma.
Uvechol resh yarche (shatta) veshabbatta, azlat veitkashsherat berucha divginta deeden deara, dekayyma ben pargoda yakkira, uminneh olif veyada ma deyada, veshat veoda leh bealma.

Tana, bitren kishshurin itkashshar nafsha, bechol resh yarcha veshabbatta, bekishshura derucha, di ben reche busemin divginta deeden deara, umittamman azil veshat, veitkashshar im rucha benishmata ditzrira bitzrora dechayye, umitravya umitzanat meinun zivin yekarin, dehay sitra, udehay sitra. hada hu dichtiv, venachacha Adonai tamid, tamid dayyka.

Vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha. mahu betzachtzachot. ella tzachuta chad, kad itkashshar berucha divginta diltatta, tzachuta dilgav min tzachuta, kad mitkashsheran benishmata dilela, bitzrora dechayye, vehayeynu betzach chad, tzachot teren, deinun leela leela, beyakkiru denishmata vadday, kelomar tzachtzachot, man yarit da, nafshecha. nafshecha mammash. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikayay.

Amar rabbi shimon, kad ana ben inun chavrayay devavel, mitkanshe gabbay, veolfe mille beitgalleyay, veinun ayyle lon begushepanka defarzela takkifa, setima mikkol sitrin. kamma zimnin olifna lon archoy deginta demalka, orchoy demalka. (nusach acher kema zimnin amena lon archoy deorayyta demalka kaddisha veorchin illain).
Kamma zimnin olifna lon kol innun dargin detzaddikaya divhahu alma, vechullehu mistafe lememar
448: Millin illen, ella laan (maalaalayn) begimguma. begini kach pesilusin ikrun, kehahu pesiluta dimgamgem befumeh.

Aval lizchuta dainna lehu, hoil umistafe. deha avira kaddisha verucha kaddisha itade minnayyhu, veyanke meavira verucha dirshuta ochora. vela od ella dekeshet itchaze alayyhu, velav inun keday lemechome sever anpoy (sefer acher deeliyyahu), kol shekken sever anpin ochoranin.

Aval da mehaneya lehu, deana shechiach bealma veana simana (nusach acher samcha) bealma, deha bechayyay la yativ alma betzaara, vela itdan bedina dilela, batray la yakum dara kedara da. vezammin alma dela yishtakkach man deyagin alayyhu, vechol anpin chatzifin yishtakkechun ben leela ben letatta. leela, bechovayyhu diltatta, vachatzifuta dilhon.

Uzeminin beni alma detzavvchin, velet man deyashgach alayyhu. yehadderun resha lechol sitre alma, vela yetuvun beasvavta. aval chad asuta ashkachna lehu bealma vela yattir, behahu atar deyishtakkechun inun delaan beorayyta, veishtakkach benayyhu (Vayikra amud alef amud alef) sefer tora dela mishtakkar beh. kad mafke hay, begineh mitare illae vetattae. vechol shekken i achtiv beh shema kaddisha kedka chaze, veha olifna milla.

Vavy ledara deitgalleyay benayyhu sefer tora, vela mitare aleh leela vetatta. man itar aleh beshata dealma betzaara tefe, veitzterich alma lemitra, veitzterich leaglaa sefer tora yattir bedochaka dealma.

Dechad alma betzaara, uvaan bene nasha rachamin ale kivre, kullehu metin mitarin aleh, deha nafsha akdimat umodaa lerucha, deha sefer tora ishtakkach begaluta, deigle bedochaka dealma, vechayyay atan uvaan rachame.

Keden rucha moda linshama, uneshama lekudesha berich hu, ucheden kudesha berich hu itar, vechas al alma, veda al galuta desefer tora meatrih, vechayyay atin lemive rachamay al kivre metayay. vavy ledara i itzterich sefer tora leaglaa leh meatar leatar, afillu mibbe kenishta leve kenishta, deha la ishtakkach benayyhu al ma yishgechun alayyhu.

Veda la yadin kullehu bene nasha, deha shechinta kad itgalleyay galuta batraa. ad la tistallak leela, ma ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 9:1) mi yittenini bammidbar melon orchim. levatar bezimna dedachaka ishtakkach tefe bealma, tamman ishtakkechat, uvegaluta desefer tora, tamman hi, vecholla mitarin aleh, illae vetattae.

Amar ribbi shimon, i hanne bavlae tippeshae, yindeun millin deraze dechachmeta, al ma kaim alma, vesamchoy al ma ka mitraggeshan. kad yishtakkach bedochaka, yindeun shevacha derav (hamenuna) yeva sava. kad ishtakkach benayyhu, vela havu yade shivcheh. veha ashkachna milloy mitkashsheran bemilloy dishlomo malka, beraza illaa dechachmeta, veinun la havu yade shevacheh.

Vehasheta azlin batar mille dechachmeta, velet man dekaim alah, velet man dekare. veim kol da, it benayyhu pikchin beibbura deshatta uvikviuta deyarche, af al gav dela ityeyhiv lehu, vela itmasar bidayyhu.

Taninan, teresar yarche, hay nefesh ihi mitkashshera begufa bekivra, veitdanu bedina kechada, bar hahi nefesh detzaddikayay, kema deukemuha, uzemina bekivra, veyada betzaara dileh, uvetzaara dechayye yada (sefer acher lo yada), vela ishtaddelat alayyhu.
Ulevatar teresar yarche, itlabbash bilvusha chad, veazil veshat bealma, veyada min rucha ma deyada, veishtedal tzaara lealma, ulemibbae rachame. uleminda (lehu) tzaara dechayye.

Uman itar lechol hay, bezimna deit zakkaa, deoda lehu kedka yeut, vehahu zakkaa ishtemoda benayyhu. detanya, zakkaa kad ishtaar bealma, ben chayyay, uven metaya ishtemoda, deha kol yoma machreze aleh benayyhu, vechad tzaara tafe bealma, vehu la yachil laagana al dara, hu oda lehu tzaara dealma.
449: Demachreze aleh benayyhu, vela ishtakkach (davar acher 33 benayyhu) man deitar lehu betzaara dealma, ella sefer tora. keden illae vetattae mitarin aleh, utzerichin kolla deyishtakkechun behahi zimna bitshuva. vei la mishtakkeche, ha mare dedina itarun alayyhu, veafillu ruach deginta deeden, mitarin alayyhu, begineh desefer tora, kidittemar.

Tana, veshachavti im avotay, begufa, benafsha, berucha, benishmata, birticha chada, bedarga illaa. amar ribbi yehuda, kamma atimin mikkolla bene alma, dela yade, vela mashgiche, vela shame, vela mistakkele bemille dealma. vehech kudesha berich hu mishtakkach alayyhu berachamin, bechol zeman veidan, velet man deyashgach.

Telat zimnin beyoma, al rucha chada bimarta dechafelta, venashiv bekivre avahata, veitseyayn kol garmin, vekayyme bekiyyuma, vehahu rucha nagid talla milleela, meresha demalka, atar demishtakkeche avahan illae. vechad mate (sefer acher matear) hahu talla minnayyhu, mitarin avahan diltatta.

Vetana, nachit hahu talla bedargin yedian, darga batar darga, umate legan eden diltatta. umehahu talla, itseche bevusemin deginta deeden. veitar rucha chada, dechalil bitren ochoranin vesalik veshat bene busemin, veayil befitcha dimarta, keden mitarin avahan, inun vezivugan, uvean rachame al benoy.

Vechad ishtakkach alma betzaara, begin deinun demichin al chove alma, vehahu talla la itnegid vela ishtakkach, ad deitar sefer tora, kedka chaze bealma. venafsha oda lerucha, verucha lenishmata, venishmata lekudesha berich hu. keden yativ malka bekurseyay derachame, venagid meattika kaddisha illaa, negidu detalla devadolcha. umate lerisha demalka, umitbarchin avahan. venagid hahu talla, leinun demichin, ucheden mitchabberan (nusach acher mitbarchan) kullehu, vechayis kudesha berich hu al alma. vetana, la chayis kudesha berich hu al alma, ad deoda laavahan uveginayyhu alma itbarcha. amar ribbi yose, vadday hachi hu, veha ashkachna mille besifra dishlomo malka, hahu illaa, dekara leh eta dechachmeta decholla.

Verav hamenuna, hachi galle veamar, deha achziyyu leh, deyattir avdat rachel, dekayyma befarashat orchin, bechol zimna deitzterich alma, mikkullehu. veraza demilla, aron vechapporet ucheruvim bechuleka devinyamin, deityelid beorcha, ushechinta al kolla:

Vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta, man rosh hammitta. da shechinta. amar rabbi shimon, chas veshalom. ella ledideh kara vesagid. (ella) ta chaze, mitta, da shechinta. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinne mittato shellishlomo. rosh hammitta man hu. da yesoda dealma, dehu risha dearsa kaddisha. al rosh, da yisrael, dekaim al rosh hammitta. begine kach, yisrael ledideh ka sagid.

Vei tema, ha behahu zimna la hava mara, deha levatar ketiv, vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vayyomer leyosef hinne avicha chole. uveshata desagid, la hava chole, veal deyada deha vehahu zimna, salik bedarga illaa kaddisha kurseyay shelemata, begine kach sagid lehahu reticha, kurseyay illaa, shelimu deilana ravreva vetakkif, deikre al shemeh. veal da, vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta, al rosh hammitta vadday, deha istallak leatreh veitattar beitroy demalka kaddisha:

Vayyomer hishshava li vayyishshava lo vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Kohelet 7:23) kol ze nissiti vachachma amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni. ha taninan, shelomo malka, yarit sihara mikkol sitroy, uveyomoy kayyma bishlemuta, hahi sihara deitbarcha mikkolla, vechad baa lemekam al nimuse orayyta. amar, amarti echkama vegomer.
Amar ribbi yehuda, yaakov amar, veshachavti im avotay unesatani mimmitzrayim ukevartani bikvuratam, tamman taninan, man denafak nishmateh birshuta ochora,
450: Vegufa dileh itkabbar beara kaddisha, aleh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:7) vattavou vattetammeu et artzi venachalati samtem letoeva, veyaakov amar ukevartani bikvuratam, venishmateh nafka birshuta ochora.

Amar ribbi yehuda, shane yaakov, dishchinta havat achidat beh, veitdabbekat beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 46:4) anochi ered immecha mitzrayma, ledayyra immach begaluta. veanochi aalcha gam alo, leizdavvevga bi nishmatach, uleitkevara gufach bekivre avahatach. may ka mayyre, (af al gav deka) (nusach acher deha lo) nafkat nishmateh birshuta ochora. (nusach acher veal da veanochi aalcha gam ala ketiv).

Veyosef yashit yado al enecha, yosef vadday, deha hu buchera dehirhura delibba, buchera detippa kadmaa havat, kidittemar. uvegin deyada kudesha berich hu temira da, itbassar leh beyosef, deha kol rechimuta beh talya.

Yashit yado al enecha. may ka mayyre. amar ribbi yesa, begin yekara deyaakov, uleitbassera deha yosef kayyaym, veyishtakkach aleh bemitateh. ribbi chizkiyya amar, milla olifna, vedachilna legallaa, uveovade alma chachmeta ishtakkach. ata ribbi abba, (davar acher 33 uneshakeh) batash beh. amar, ema milach, vezayyen zayynach. beyomoy deribbi shimon millin itgalleyayn.

Amar, olifna mippirkin derav yesa sava, benimmuse alma. bar nash dezache levar behay alma, libbae leh lenagda afra al enoy kad itkabbar, veda hu yekara dileh, leachazaa dealma astim minneh, vehu yarit leh lealma techotoy.

Begin deenoy devar nash, chezu dealma beh itchaze, vechol gevavnin hachi inun deascharu. chivvavra deveh, hu yamma rabba okyanos, deaschar kol alma bechol sitre. goona ochora hu yabbeshta (daakaypav), deafiku maya, veyabbeshta kaim ben maya, hachi hu goona ben maya.

Goona ochora telitaa, hi bimtziuta deveh, da yerushala 40, dehi emtzauta dealma. goona reviaa, hi chezu dechol ena, veikre bat ayin, divhahu bat ayin, itchaze partzufa. vechezu yekara mikkolla, da tziyyon, deihi nekuda emtzauta mikkolla, dechezu dechol alma tamman itchaze. vetamman sharya shechinta, dehi shappiru decholla, vechezu decholla, veena da hu yerutat alma. uvegine kach, hay shavik leh, vehay natil leh, veyarit leh.

Amar leh, shappir kaamart, aval milla setima ihu yattir, uvene alma la yadin, vela mistakkelan, deha beshata devar nash nafik mealma. nafsha dileh temira immeh, vead la nafkat, enoy debar nash chamu ma dechamu, kema deokimna dichtiv, (Shemot 33:20) ki lo yirani haadam vachay. bechayyehon la chaman, aval bemitathon chaman.

Veenoy pekichan mehahu chezu dechama, veinun dekayymin aleh, baa leshava yada al enoy, uleastama enoy, begin hahu deolifna beraza denimmuse alma. divshata deishtaaru enoy pekichan, mehahu chezu yakkira dechama. i zache levar, bera kadim leshava yadeh al enoy uleastama lon, kema dichtiv veyosef yashit yado al enecha. begin deha chezu ochora dela kaddisha izdammenat lekovleh, veena dechama hasheta chezu kaddisha illaa, la yistakkal bechezu ochora.

Veod, dehahu nefesh semichat lekovleh beveta, vei ishtaar ena pekicha, vehahu chezu ochora yishre al enoy, bechol ma deistakkal itlatya, velav yekara deena hu, vechol shekken mikrivoy, vechol shekken min mita, delav yekara dileh leistakkala bamme dela itzterich, uleashraya al enoy milla ochora. levatar itkasya beafra, veha itaru chavraya al dina dekivra mahu. vikara hu, deyastim ena min kolla, al yeda divreh deshavak bealma.
Ta chaze, kol shiva yomin, nafsha azla mibbeta lekivra, umikkivra leveta, veitabbalat aleh, utelat zimnin beyoma, itdanu kechada nafsha vegufa, velet man deyada bealma, veyashgach leatara libba.
Levatar, gufa itterid, venafsha azla veissetachya
451: Baggehinnam, venafka veshata bealma, umevakra lekivreh, ad demitlabbesha bemma deitlabbesha.

Levatar teresar yarche, nayychin kolla. gufa shavik (shachich) beafra. nafsha ittzerer veitnehir berucha, bemana deitlabbash. rucha itannag beginta deeden. nishmata salka litzrora deinnuga dechol innugin. vecholla itkashshar da beda lezimnin yedian.

Ta chaze, vavy lon livne nasha, dela mistakkelin vela yadin vela ishtemodan, al ma kayyme, veyitneshe minnayyhu lemebad pikkude orayyta. deit pikkude orayyta deavde levush yekar leela. veit pikkude orayyta deavde levush yekar letatta. veit pikkude orayyta deavde levushe yekar lehay alma. vecholla itzterichan leh lebar nash, umin yomoy mammash, kullehu mittaknan, kema deokimna.

Ribbi yehuda sava, itraggish bedateh yoma chad, veachazu leh bechelmeh, chad diukena minnehora dileh, takkif, deizdehar learba sitrin, amar leh, may hay. amar leh, levusha dilach hu, lediyyura dehacha, umehahu yoma hava chade.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kol yoma veyoma, ruchin detzaddikayay yatvin bilvushehon, shurin shurin beginta deeden, umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu, bikara illaa. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha. amar ribbi abba, bekadmita ma ketiv vayyishtachu yisrael vegomer, kema deokimna, man mitta, da keneset yisrael. rosh hammitta, da tzaddik. al rosh hammitta, da malka kaddisha, dishlama kolla dileh, kema dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 3:7) hinne mittato shellishlomo. deyaakov ledideh ka sagid, lehahu dekaim al rosh hammitta, yisrael shemeh, begini kach, vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta.

Levatar, kevan deyada yaakov, deha bedarga illaa ishtelim, vedarga dileh hu leela im avahata, vehu bilchodoy tikkuna shelemata, achsin libbeh, vechade veittakkaf biruta illaa dekudesha berich hu beh. ma ketiv beh, vayyitchazzek yisrael vayyeshev al hammitta, al hammitta mammash, deha bedarga illaa yattir ishtallam, zakkaa chulakeh.

Tana, amar ribbi yehuda, bematnitta dilan okimna, ha detaninan bearbaa perakim bashshana haolam niddon, bappesach al hattevua, baatzeret al perot hailan, berosh hashshana kol bae haolam ovrim lefanav kivne meron, uvachag niddonin al hammayim, ha okimna mille. veraza dematnitta okimna, befesach al hattevua vechulei, lokovel reticha illaa, raza deavahan, vedavid malka. befesach al hattevua, dehachi hu mammash, veha okimna milla da, al ma atyay matztza befesach, veha dina hu, dina demalchuta dina, veda sheruta deshariu yisrael lemeal bechulaka kaddisha dekudesha berich hu, ulevaara minnayyhu chametz, deihu taavavn ochoranin di memannan al ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot deikrun elohim acherim, elohe nichar. veikrun chametz, yetzer hara, ulemeal bematztza, chulaka kaddisha dekudesha berich hu ammay tevua. (sefer acher 33 kema deat amar, 0 tevuatah beHei, ramiz 36 kadmaa dishma kaddisha) begin kach, befesach niddonin al hattevua, veokimna dealma itdan al dina deh.

Baatzeret al perot hailan. perot hailan, perot hailanot mibbae leh, man perot hailan. ella, da hu ilana ravreva vetakkif leela. perot hailan, kema dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:9) ani kivrosh raanan mimmenni peryecha nimtza.

Berosh hashshana ovrin lefanav kivne maron. tana rosh hashshana, da hu resha deshatta demalka, uman hu rosh hashshana, da yitzchak, deikre rosh, deihu chad resha demalka (nusach acher leella), atar deikre shana. begine kach kol bae olam ovrin lefanav kivne maron. veal da taninan, berosh hashshana, deha beresha deshatta share yitzchak.

Uvachag niddonin al hammayim, da hu sheruta (deresha) dimina demalka, veal da chedvavta demaya ishtakkach becholla, beshata denasche maya, veshaave lon, begin demayim da yedia. veal da bearbaa perakim illen, kolla mishtakkechin.
452: Amar ribbi yose, kad yistakkelun mille, kolla ishtakkach behanni pirkin, avraham yitzchak veyaakov, david malka. uvehanni alma itdan, uvearba perakin bene nasha itdanu, beyomin deishtakkachu bealma. uvechol yoma veyoma, sifrin petichan veovadin ketivin, velet man deyashgach, velet man deyarchin udeneh, veorayyta ashidat beh bechol yoma, vekala kare vechela, (Mishlei 9:4) mi peti yasur henna chasar lev amra lo, velet man deyatzit lekaleh.

Tana beshata devar nash kaim betzafra, sahadin kayymin lekovleh, vesahadin beh, vehu la ashgach. nishmata ashidat aleh, bechol iddan uvechol shata, i atzit yaot. vei lav, ha sifrin petichin veovadin ketivin. amar ribbi chiyyay, zakkain inun tzaddikayay, dela mistafu min dina, la bealma den, vela bealma deate. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 28:1) vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach. uchetiv, (Tehillim 37:29) tzaddikim yirshu aretz.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Bereshit 15:12) vayhi hashshemesh lavo vetardema nafla al avram vegomer, hay kera ukemuha. aval da yoma dedina kashya, deafke leh lebar nash mehay alma. detanya, (hahu yoma) zimna demata devar nash nafik mehay alma, hahu (yoma) zimna yoma dedina rabba, deitchashshach shimsha min sihara, kema dichtiv, (Kohelet 12:2) ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh, da nishmata kaddisha, deitmenaat mibbar nash, telatin yomin, ad la yippuk mealma (veha chaze), vechama detzulema deitmenaat minneh vela itchaze.

May tama itmenaat minneh. begin denishmeta kaddisha salkat, veitavarat minneh, vela itchaze. dela tema, dechad mit bar nash veitchallash, hay nishmata itavarat minneh, ella kad ihu bechayyav, betukepeh, itavarat minneh (veitchallash) hay nishmeta, vela nahara lerucha, verucha la nahir lenafsha, keden tzulema itavarat minneh, vela nahir leh. (ella) mehahu yoma, kolla machreze aleh, veafillu tzippore shemaya. may tama. begin denishmata ha salka minneh, verucha la nahir lenafsha, keden nafsha itchallashat, umechla vechol tiuveta degufa, salka minneh veitavar.

Veamar ribbi yehuda, veafillu kol zimna denafil inish beve mareh, vela yachil letzallaa, nishmata itavarat vesalka minneh, ucheden la nahir rucha lenafsha, ad dedayynin dinih devar nash. vei dayynin leh levar nash letav, keden nishmata ithadderat leatrah, unehira lecholla. ha bezimna dekayyma milla bedina. uvezimna dela kayyma milla bedina, telatin yomin akdimat nishmata lecholla, vetzulema itavar minneh.

Tana, bezimna dedayynin leh levar nash leela, salkin lenishmateh leve dina, vedayynin al memraha, vehi ashidat becholla, veashidat bechol raayoni devar nash, uveovadin la ashidat, deha kullehu besifra chetivin. vechullehu dayynin leh lebar nash, behahi shata dedayynin leh lebar nash leela, keden dochaka degufa ishtakkach, yattir mishshear zimnayay.

I dayynin leh letav, keden arpin minneh. vezea itbakka al gufa, venishmata ahadderat levatar, venahara lecholla. vela salik bar nash mibbe mareh lealmin, ad dedayynin dineh leela. vei tema, ha kamma chayyayve alma, kamma rashshie alma, kayymin bekiyyumayyhu. ella, kudesha berich hu ashgach bedineh debar nash, af al gav dehashta la zache, vehu chame deha levatar zache, dain leh letav. o lezimnin deolid bar, deyeheve zakkaa bealma, veal da kudesha berich hu dain leh letav.

Vechol ovadoy vedinoy dekudesha berich hu letav, uvecholla ashgach. kema dichtiv, (Yechezkel 33:11) chay ani neum Adonai vegomer im echpotz bemot harasha ki im beshuv rasha middarko. uvegin da, kol inun chayyayve alma, dekayymin bekiyyumayyhu, kudesha berich hu dain lon letav.
Ulezimnin, deinun marin ishtallimu zimnayyhu, millemishre tamman. kema deat amer, (Devarim 28:59) vocholaim raim veneemanim, deavadu mehemnuta. dechad sharian aleh devar
453: Nash, mistalleke minneh levatar deashlimu zimnayyhu, ben letzaddikayay, ben lechayyayvaya, vecholla itavad bedina kidkaamaran:

Vayyar yisrael et bene yosef vayyomer mi elle, amar ribbi yitzchak, hay kera kashya, dichtiv vayyar yisrael, uchetiv veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken lo yuchal lirot, i lo yuchal lirot, mahu vayyar yisrael. ella dechama beruach kudesha, inun bene yosef, deinun yaravam vachaverav. deyaravam avad teren egle zahav, veamar (Melachim 1 12) elle elohecha yisrael. uvegin kach, mi elle, man hu dezammin lememar elle elohecha letaavavn ochoran, uvegin kach vayyar yisrael et bene yosef.

Mikkan, detzaddikayay chaman ovada lemerachok, vekudesha berich hu meatter lon beitra dileh, ma kudesha berich hu chame lemerachok, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod, dekudesha berich hu chama kol ovadin, ad la yaaved lon, vechullehu aavaru kammeh.

Kegavvna da, kol darin dealma, misseyayfe alma, ad seyayfe alma, kullehu itattadu vekayymu kammeh ad la yetun lealma. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 41:4) kore haddorot merosh, ad la itbere alma. begin dechol nishmatin denachatin lealma, ad la yechatun, kullehu kayyme kammeh dekudesha berich hu, bediukena dekayyme behay alma, veikrun bishmahan, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) lechullam beshem yikra.

Uf hachi tzaddikayyay, kudesha berich hu achme lon kol darin dealma, ad la yetun veyishtakkechun bealma. mena lan meadam (da adam) dehava kadmaa. dekudesha berich hu achme leh kol inun darin ad la yetun, kedichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:1) ze sefer toldot (adam). detaninan, achme leh, kol inun darin dezamminin lemete lealma. vechen lemoshe, dichtiv, (Devarim la) vayyarehu Adonai et kol haaretz, dekudesha berich hu achme leh kol darin dealma, vechol inun manhige alma, vechol shear nevie, ad la yetun lealma.

Uf hacha, vayyar yisrael et bene yosef, chama lemerachok, veizdaza, veamar mi elle. vehay kera ashlim litren sitrin, lehay sitra, ulehay sitra. veal da ativ yosef veamar, banay hem asher natan li elohim baze. umena lan dekudesha berich hu achme leh berucha dekudesha. dichtiv vehinni hera oti elohim gam et zarecha. gam, leasgaa inun denafkin minneh kidkaamaran:

Vayvarecha et yosef vayyomar haelohim asher vegomer, behay kera it leistakkala beh, vayvarech et yosef, dela ashkechan hacha beracha divrich leh leyosef ella livnoy. i livnoy, vayvarachem mibbae leh, mahu vayvarech et yosef, vela ashkechan hacha deitberich yosef.
Amar ribbi yose, et dayyka, ketiv et yosef, bircheta divnoy hava, vechad itbarchan benoy, ihu mitbarech. devircheta divnoy devar nash birchateh ihi.

Amar ribbi elazar, vayvarech et yosef, et dayyka, devarich leat kayyayma, raza (nusach acher divrit begin dechevan deamar bene hem asher natan li elohim baze, keden berich lehahu atar raza) divrit denatar yosef, uvegin kach ikre tzaddik, et deyosef, raza divrit dekayyma bahadeh deyosef:

Haelohim asher hithallechu avotay lefanav. haelohim, da raza divrit kaddisha, keyayma kaddisha. avotay lefanav, dayyka lefanav, deinun kadmae illae, mikkamme raza dena, avraham veyitzchak, deha minnehon ittezan veyanka hahu (nusach acher mehahu) atar.

Haelohim haroe oti, may tama zimna ochora haelohim. ella raza illaa ihu, vehacha barich lehahu atar, beraza deelohim chayyim, mekora dechayye, deminneh nafkin birchan. uvegin da adkar garmeh behay atar, veamar, haelohim haroe oti, begin dechol birchan denagde mimmekora dechayye, yaakov natil lon. vechevan denatil lon ihu, hay atar natal birchan, vecholla ihu talyay (nusach acher bidchura) bedibbura. veal da vayvarech et yosef ketiv.
Begin kach, bechol atar devirchan itzterichu levarcha, bae kudesha berich hu leitbarcha bekadmita, ulevatar itbarchu ochoranin, vei kudesha berich hu la itbarich bekadmita, inun birchan la
454: Vei tema, ha yaakov devarcheh avuha, vela barcheh lekudesha berich hu bekadmita. ta chaze, beshata devarich yitzchak leyaakov, la barcheh, ad devarich lekudesha berich hu bekadmita. kevan devarich lekudesha berich hu bekadmita, barcheh leyaakov. mena lan, dichtiv (Bereshit 26:12) vayyomer ree reach beni kereach sade asher beracho Adonai. hacha kiyyem beracha lekudesha berich hu. dichtiv, asher beracho Adonai, itbarech bekiyyuma devirchan, ulevatar ketiv batrih, veyitten lecha vegomer. kevan dehahu sade itkeyyaym bekayyma devirchan, (sefer acher baberakevay, miyyad barcheh, vayyitten lecha haelohim, dehahu sade raza) denafke mineh birchan, levatar deihu itkeyyaym bevirchoy. kegavvna da barich yaakov bekadmita lekudesha berich hu, ulevatar barich livnoy. ta chaze, betzafra bae bar nash leakdama birchan lekudesha berich hu, ulevatar lishar bene alma, veha okimna dichtiv babboker yochal ad vegomer.

Veta chaze, kad baa yaakov levarcha leinun bene yosef, chama beruach kudesha dezamin lenafka meefrayim yaravam ben nevat. patach veamar, mi elle. mashma (sefer acher may shena) deamar baavoda da desitra deavoda zara (Shemot lak) elle elohecha yisrael. ella raza ihu, kol inun sitrin dehahu chivya bisha, umissitra dehahu ruach mesaava hahu chivya. (Shemot 236 amud bet) veit man derachiv aleh, vechad mizdavvgan, ikrun elle. veinun mizdammenin bealma, bechol inun sitrin dillehon.

Veruach dekudesha ikre zot, deihu raza divrit, reshima kaddisha deishtakkach tadir bebar nash, vechen (Shemot 15:2) ze eli veanvihu, (yeshaya ko) ze Adonai. (sefer acher hu Adonai) aval illen, ikrun elle, veal da ketiv, elle elohecha yisrael.

Uvegin kach ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:15) gam elle tishshachachna, veanochi raza dezot, lo eshkachech. uchetiv, (Eicha 1:16) al elle ani bochiya, dehahu chova garma lon lemivke kamma bechiyyayn. davar acher al elle ani, may tama. begin deityeyhiv reshu leatar da leshalletaa al yisrael, ulecharava be makdesha, uvegin deityeyhiv lon reshu leshalletaa, (sefer acher ketiv, 2 al elle ani vochiyya, raza demilla da sitra dimsaava deityeyhiv lon reshu leshalletaa) ani bochiya, da ruach kudesha deikre ani.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Devarim 28:69) elle divre habberit. hachi hu vadday, dechol illen la mitkayyme, ella miggo elle, detamman kol levavtin sharyayn, kema deokimna deihu arur. uvegin da akdim veamar elle, dekayyma leman deavar divre habberit.

(Vayikra 27:34) elle hammitzvot asher tzivva Adonai, begin dechol pikkuda deorayyta leitdakkaa bar nash, vela yiste meorcha da, veyistammar mittamman, veyitperash minnayyhu. vei tema (Bereshit 6:9) elle toldot noach. hachi hu vadday, deha nafak cham, deihu avi chenaan, uchetiv, (Bereshit 49) arur kenaan veihu raza da deelle.

Veal da (sefer acher kol hane hittucha susefita dedahava, veal da ketiv mi elle, yisrael kad avdon egla) ketiv vayyomru ele elohecha yisrael, vechol hanne hittucha sosfita dedahava. aharon kariv dahava, deihu sitra dileh, dechalil ihu betukefa deesha, vecholla chad, vesitra da dahava veeshsha. (davar acher 33 leittakkefa) ruach mesaava, deishtakkach tadir bemadbera, ashkach atar behahu zimna, leatkafa beh.

Uma dehavu yisrael dachyayn mehahu zuhama kadmaa deatil bealma, degarim mota lealma, kad kamu al tura desinay, levatar ahadaru, vegarim lo kemillekaddemin, lesaava lon, uleittakfa alayyhu. vegarim lon mota, ulechol alma, ledarehon batrayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 82:6) ani amarti elohim attem vegomer achen keadam vegomer.

Veal da kad chama yaakov leyaravam ben nevat deavad kochavim umazzalot, veamar elle elohecha, izdaza, veamar mi elle. kad baa levatar levarcha lon, barich leh (sefer acher lishchinta bekadmita, ulevatar) barich (lon) livnoy. kevan devarich lekudesha berich hu bekadmita, levatar mehahu atar devarich bekadmita, barich lon. hada hu dichtiv hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el Adonai. ha ukemuha, dela litzle bar nash ella samuch lechotla, vela yehe milla chatzitz beneh leven kotla. dichtiv vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir. may shena bechullehu detzalle tzelota, dela ketiv behu vayyassev panav el hakkir, deha day leh deyema veyitpallel el Adonai, deha man dematzle tzelota, ihu kivvivn dateh kedka yeut, deha ketiv bemoshe, (Bamidbar 11:2) vayyitpallel moshe el Adonai. (Shemot 11:9) vayyitzak moshe el Adonai vela ketiv
455: Vayyassev panav. hacha bechizkiyyahu, may tama vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir, ulevatar vayyitpallel.

Ella raza demilla ihu, detaninan, chizkiyya behahu zimna la hava nasiv, vela hava leh intu, vela olid benin, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 38:1) vayyavo elav vegomer ki met atta velo tichye, vetaninan ki met atta baolam hazze, vela tichye baolam habba. may tama, begin dela olid benin.

Dechol man dela ishtaddal leolada benin behay alma, la mitkayyem bealma deate, vela yehe leh chulaka behahu alma. veittarchat nishmateh bealma (deate), vela ashkachat nayycha beatar dealma. veda hu onasha dichtiv beorayyta, (Vayikra 20:20) aririm yamutu, umetargeminan bela velad. begin deman deihu bela velad, kad azil behahu alma, mit hu tamman. mit bealma den, uvealma deate. veal da ketiv ki met atta velo tichye.

Velo od, ella dishchinta la sharya aloy kelal, keden ketiv vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir. olifna deshavve raayonoy, vechavvevn anpohi lemesav itteta, begin detishre aloy shechinta, raza dekir.

Uvegin kach ketiv levatar, vayyitpallel el Adonai, mikkan olifna, deman deit beh chova, uvae lemive rachame aloy, yechavven anpoy veraayonoy, leatkana garmeh mehahu chova, ulevatar yive tzelota. kema deat amer, (Eicha 3:40) nachpesa derachenu venachkora bekadmita, ulevatar venashuva. uf hacha, kevan deyada chizkiyyahu choveh, ma ketiv vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir, shavve anpoy leatkana legabbe shechinta, deha legabbe atar da chav.

Begin dishchinta kol nukeve dealma kayymin besitraha. man deit leh nukeva, sharya ihi legabbeh, uman delet leh, la sharya legabbeh. veal da atkin garmeh legabbah leatkana, veshavve aleh leitnasseva, ulevatar veyitpallel el Adonai.

Kir, da hu adon kol haaretz, veda shechinta, kema deat amer, (Yehoshua 3:11) hinne aron habberit adon kol haaretz. kir, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 22:5) mekarkar kir veshoa. kirkura unehima dekir, deihu adon, kad itchariv be makdesha, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) rachel mevakka al baneha, veha okimna. uvegin kach vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir.

Ta chaze, bitzlota ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 38:3) ana Adonai zechar na et asher hithallachti lefanecha, ramaz hacha, denatar berit kaddisha, vela saiv leh, venatar leh kedka yeut. ketiv hacha hithallachti lefanecha, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 17:1-2) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim veettena veriti beni uvenecha, denatar berit kaddisha kedka yeut. beemet uvelev shalem, deitkavvevn bechol inun raze mehemnuta dichlilan beemet.

Vehattov beenecha asiti, desamach geula litfilla, veha okimna. veha ukemuha chavrayay, deitkavvevn leyachada yichuda kedka yeut. uvegin kach, vayyevchi chizkiyyahu bechi gadol, delet tara dekayyma kamme dimin. geula, da hu malach haggoel, deda ihu deishtakkach bechol peroka dealma, veha okimna.

Hammalacha haggoel oti mikkol ra. ribbi elazar amar, kevan devarich yaakov veitkavvevn mittatta leela, keden amshich meela letatta, dichtiv haelohim haroe oti, kevan deihu natil, yahiv birchan lehay atar, kevan deamte birchan lehay atar, keden patach veamar hammalach haggoel vegomer.

Patach veamar, (Melachim 1 8:7) ki hakkeruvim porse kenafayim el mekom haaron vegomer. ta chaze, keruvim beat uvenisa havu kayyme, telat zimnin beyoma havu parse gadfehon, vesachche al arona letatta, dichtiv porse chenafayim, peruse la ketiv, ella porse.

Veta chaze, kudesha berich hu avid letatta kegavvna dilela, keruvim, diukena dilhon kechezu ravyayn, vekayymin techot hay atar, mimina umismala, veillen itbarchan bekadmita mehanehu birchan denagdan meela, umehacha nagde birchan letatta.
Veal da ketiv, hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra. oti, denatil birchan miggevavnin dilela, vechevan deihu natil, yevarech et hannearim, da raza dichruvim, deminnayyhu nagde
456: Hammalacha haggoel oti mikkol ra yevarech et hannearim vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 19:14) bayit vahon nachalat avot, vechi nachalat avot inhu, veha kudesha berich hu yahiv kolla lebar nash. ella, dechevan deachsin beta levar nash umamona, lezimnin deyachasin kolla livreh, vihe achsana deavot. aval umeAdonai ishsha maskalet, begin deitteta, kad achsin lah bar nash, meim kudesha berich hu achsin lah, deha la yachsin lah kudesha berich hu lebar nash, ella kad machrizin aleh birkia.

Dekudesha berich hu mezavvevg zivugin, ad la yetun lealma. vechad zachu bene nasha lefum ovadehon, hachi yahave lon itteta, vecholla itgalleyayn kammeh dekudesha berich hu, ulefum ovadin dezakkain, hachi mezavvivg ziuugin.

Ulezimnin deka seliku biklitin, veaste hahu bar nash archeh, salik ziuugeh leochora, ad deyichshar ovadoy, vechad yichshar ovadoy, o demate zimneh, itdache gevar mikkamme gevar, veate hay venatil dileh. veda kashe kammi kudesha berich hu mikkolla ledachya bar nash mikkamme gavra ochora, uvegin kach kudesha berich hu ihu yahiv itteta lebar nash, uminneh atyayn ziuugin. veal da umeAdonai ishsha maskalet.

Begin kach, kudesha berich hu yahiv kolla levar nash. vei tema ishsha maskalet vela ochora. ta chaze, af al gav dekudesha berich hu azmin tavan lebar nash lemehav leh, vehu aste archoy meim kudesha berich hu legabbe sitra ochora, mehahu sitra ochora deitdabbak beh, yete leh man deyete, bechol (nusach acher kol) kitrugin, vechol bishin, vela atyayn leh meim kudesha berich hu, ella mehahu sitra bisha deitdabbak beh, beinun ovadin deavad.

Veal da, itteta delav ihi maskelet, kara al da shelomo, (Kohelet 7:26) umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha. begin dechovoy debar nash, hu mashich aleh, beinun ovadin deavad. veal da kad kudesha berich hu itrae beh bevar nash, begin ovadoy dechashran, ihu azmin leh intu deihi maskelet, ufarik leh befurekan, miggo sitra ochora.

Veal da amar yaakov, hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra. may mikkol ra, dela izdammenat li itteta, deihi miggo sitra ochora, vela iara pesul bezari (sefer acher baarasey), dechullehu tzaddike usheleme bishlimu, begin deitperak mikkol ra, veyaakov la itdabbak behahu sitra ochora kelal.

Veal da, hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra yevarech et hannearim. may tama itchazu leitbarcha, begin denatir yosef at kayyayma kaddisha, veal da amar yosef banay hem asher natan li elohim baze, achme leh raza divrit denatar leh. uvegin denatar leh, itchazu leitbarcha veitchaze ihu levirchan saggiin. begin da lechullehu yahav bircha chad, uleyosef birchan saggiin, mashma dichtiv birchot avicha gavru al birchot horay vegomer, birchot shadayim varacham tihyena lerosh yosef.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Rosh Chodesh amud bet) (Tehillim 123:1) elecha nasati et enay hayyoshvi bashshamayim, hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, tzelota debar nash deitkavvevn bah, ihu leela leumeka illaa, demittamman nagde kol birchan vechol cheru, umittamman nafke lekayyma kolla.

Veal da yattir yod, begin dela pasik yod, meatar da lealmin. uvegin da ketiv, hayyoshvi bashshamayim, achid leela, beraza dechachmeta illaa, veachid letatta, deyativ al karseya deavahan, yativ al karseya deikre shamayim, uvegin kach hayyoshvi bashshamayim ketiv.

Umehacha, kad birchan nagde meela meumeka da, kullehu natil lon hay atar deikre shamayim, umehay nagde letatta, ad dematu letzaddikayyay keyayma dealma, umehacha mitbarchin kol inun chayyaylin, vechol inun mashshiryayn liznayyhu, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, beshivin uteren nehorin, istallak atara dechol mashshiryayn, iggula dealma, beshivin duchete, chad iggula lechullehu (leel 53 amud bet) bego hahu iggula nekuda chada dekayyma beemtzaita, mehay nekuda, ittezanat kol hahu iggula, bet kodesh hakkodashim, ihu atar
457: Lehahu rucha dechol ruchin (sefer acher hacha raza dechol razin) ittammar begavveh. hay temiru ihu bego chelaha, temira ihu bego lego, kad salka da, kolla salkin avatrah. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:4) mashcheni acharecha narutza.

Ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yose veribbi yehuda havu azle beorcha, amar ribbi yose, kol chad vechad minan lema mille deorayyta. patach ribbi yehuda veamar, (Tehillim 79:8) al tizkar lanu avonot rishonim maher yekadmunu vegomer. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu, birchimuta deyisrael, rachim lon, deinun adveh veachsanteh, la mistakkal ochora bedinayyhu, bar ihu bilchodeh. vechevan deihu mistakkel bedinayyhu, itmale alayyhu rachamin, begin deihu keav derachim al banim, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 103:13) kerachem av al banim richam Adonai vegomer. vechevan deishtakkach lon chovin, maavar lon rishon rishon, ad deaavar lon lechullehu mikkammeh. vechevan deaavar lon mikkammeh, la ishtaar alayyhu chovin lemehav shaltanu lesitra ochora dedina alayyhu.

Ate lemechav kammeh kedbekadmita, inun chovin kadmae deaavar mikkammeh chashiv alayyhu, veal da ketiv al tizkar lanu avonot rishonim maher yekadmunu rachamecha vegomer. dei rachamecha lo yakdimu alayyhu deyisrael, la yachlin lekayyma bealma. begin dechamma inun mare dedina kashya, mare terisen, vechamma diltorin dekayyme alayyhu deyisrael leela, veilmale deakdim kudesha berich hu rachamim alayyhu deyisrael, ad la yashgach bedinehon, la yachlin lekayyma bealma. veal da, maher yekadmunu rachamecha ki dalonu meod. dalluta deovadin tavin, dalluta deovadin dechashran. (kamme kudesha berich hu).

Ta chaze, ilmale yesaggelun yisrael ovadin dechashran kamme kudesha verich hu, la havu kaimu aleh ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bealma, aval yisrael inun garmin lishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot lezakfa reshayyhu bealma. deilmale yisrael la yehon chatan kamme kudesha berich hu shear amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot itkafyayn kammayyhu.

Veta chaze, ilmale deamshichu yisrael beovadin bishin listar ochora beara kaddisha, ha ittemar, dela shaltu shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot beara kaddisha, vela itgalu meal ara. veal da ketiv, ki dallonu meod. delet lan ovadin dechashran kedka chaze. uvegin kach ki dallonu meod maher yekadmunu rachamecha.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira vegilu birada, uchetiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. ta chaze, kol bar nash deate lemiflach leh lekudesha berich hu, betzafra uvefanya bae lemiflach leh lekudesha berich hu.

Betzafra kad salik nehora, veitaruta distar yemina itar bealma, keden bae bar nash leitkashshera bimina dekudesha berich hu, ulemiflach kammeh befulechana ditzlota. begin ditzlota achsin tukefa leela, veamshich birchan meumeka illaa lechullehu almin, umittamman amshich birchan letattae. veishtakkechu illain vetattain mitbarchan, behahu pulechana ditzlota.

Pulechana ditzlota, deka bae bar nash lemiflach kamme kudesha berich hu, (Shemot 29 amud alef) besimcha uvirnana leachlala lichneset yisrael benayyhu, ulevatar leyaychada yichuda kedka chaze. dichtiv, (Tehillim 100:3) deu ki Adonai hu elohim, da raza deyichuda beraza defulechana.

Veim kol da, bae bar nash lemiflach kammeh dekudesha berich hu bechedva, uleachazaa chedva befulechaneh, veillen teren simcha urenana, lokovel teren illen, teren tzelotin, teren kurebanin leyoma lokovel teren illen, deinun simcha urenana. simcha betzafra, urenana beramsha. veal da, (Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves echad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim.

Veal da, tzelota dearvit reshut ihi, begin dehahi shata mechallek tarpa lechol chelaha, v lav shata leadkara (nusach acher leitbarcha) ella lemehav mezona. bimama hi mitbarechet mitteren sitrin illen, betzafra uveramsha miggo simcha urenana, uvelelya palig birchan lecholla kedka chaze, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vegomer.
Patach ribbi chizkiyya veamar, (Tehillim 141:2) tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha masat kappay minchat arev. ammay minchat arev vela tzelota
458: Detzafra, dela ketiv tikkon tefillati babboker. ella hachi ittemar, tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanycha, ketoret la atya ella al chedva, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev. veal da kahana kad adlik botzinin, hava makriv ketoret, kema deat amer, (Shemot 30:7-8) behetivo et hannirot yaktirenna uvehaalot aharon et hannirot ben haarbayim yaktirenna. betzafra, al chedva, deshata garim. beramsha, lemechode setar semala, vehachi itchaze. ulealam la ate ella al chedva.

Veta chaze ketoret mekashsher kishrin, veachid leela vetatta, veda aavar mota vekitruga verugeza, dela yachil leshaltaa bealma. kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 17:11) vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta veten aleha esh meal hammizbeach vesim ketoret veholech mehera vegomer. levatar da ketiv, vayyaratz (aharon) vegomer, vaychapper al haam, uchetiv, vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim vatteatzar hammaggefa. begin dela yachlin kol sitrin bishin vechol mekatregin lemekam kamme ketoret. veal da ihu raza (sefer acher chedva) decholla vekishshura decholla.

Uveshata demincha, dedina sharya bealma, itkavvevn david behahu tzelota. dichtiv, tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha vegomer. vehay tzelota desalik, yaaver rugeza dedina kashya, deshallit hasheta behay zimna, behahu ketoret. dedache veaavar kammeh kol rugeza, (desalik hasheta behay shaata behahu ketoret deade kol rugeza) vechol kitruga dealma, (sefer acher 33 hayeynu dichtiv) (sefer acher may tama begin deihi) minchat arev, dedina talya bealma.

Ta chaze, kad itcharav be makdesha, beshata deittokad, zeman mincha hava. veal da ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. man tzille arev. inun mekatregin dealma, verugeze dedinin, dizminin behahi shata. veal da taninan, devae (Shemot 36 amud bet) bar nash lechavvevna dateh, bitzlota demincha. bechullehu tzelota bae bar nash lechavvevna dateh, uvehay tzelota yattir mikkullehu, begin dedina sharya bealma. veal da zeman tzelota demincha, yitzchak takkin leh, veha ukemuha.

Ad dehavu azle, oolu bechad tura. amar ribbi yose, hay tura dachala, nihach vela nitakkev hacha, begin detura dechila hu. amar ribbi yehuda, i hava chad, hava amina hachi. deha taninan, deman deazil yechiday beorcha, itchayyayv benafsheh. aval telata la. vechol chad vechad minan, itchaze dela taade minan shechinta.

Amar ribbi yose, ha taninan dela yismoch bar nash al nissa. menalan, mishmuel. dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 16:2) ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani, veha itchaze shemuel yattir minan. amar leh, afillu hachi, ihu hava chad, vehezzeka ishtakkach leena. aval anan telata, vehezzeka la ishtakkach leena. dei mishshum mazzikin. ha taninan, delitlata la mitchaze vela mazke. vei mishshum listim, la mishtakkeche hacha, deha rachik meyishuva hay tura, uvene nasha la mishtakkeche hacha. beram dechilu hu, dechevavn bara demishtakkechin hacha.

Patach veamar. hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra, hay kera it leistakkala beh, (sefer acher 33 deha ketiv) haggoel, asher gaal mibbae leh, may haggoel. begin dehu mishtakkach tadir legabbe bene nasha, vela aade mibbar nash zakkaa lealmin. ta chaze, hammalach haggoel oti da shechinta, deazil immeh debar nash tadir, vela aade minneh, kad bar nash natir pikkude orayyta. veal da yizdaher bar nash, dela yippuk yechiday beorcha. may yechiday, deyizdaher bar nash lemittar pikkude deorayyta, begin dela taade minneh shechinta, veyitztarech lemezal yechiday, bela ziuuga dishchinta.

Ta chaze, kad nafik bar nash leorcha, yesaddar tzelota kame mareh, begin leamshacha aleh shechinta, ulevatar yippuk leorcha, veyishkach ziuuga dishchinta, lemifrak leh beorcha, uleshezava leh bechol ma deitzterich.
Ma ketiv beyaakov, (Bereshit 28:20) im yihye elohim immadi, da zivuga dishchinta. ushemarani badderech hazze, lemifrak li mikkolla, veyaakov yechiday hava
459: Behahu zimna, ushechinta azlat kammeh. kol shekken chavrayay deit benayyhu millin deorayyta, al achat kamma vechamma. (amar rabbi yose, vadday kach hu, addehachi maich shimsha learva.)

Amar ribbi yose, may naavid, i nitakkev hacha, ha yoma maich lemeal. i nehach leela, tura rav ihu, udechilu dechevavn chakla dachilna. amar ribbi yehuda, tevavhna alach ribbi yose. amar leh ha taninan dela yismoch bar nash al nisa, dekudesha berich hu la yarchish nisa bechol shata. amar leh, hane mile yechiday, aval anachna telata, umille orayyta benana, ushechinta immana, la dachilna.

Ad dehavu azle, chamu leela betura, tinnara chad, vechad mearta begavvav. amar ribbi yehuda, nihach venesak lehahu tinara, deana chame chada mearta tamman. seliku letamman, vechamu hahi mearta. amar ribbi yose, dachilna, dilma hahi mearta atar dilchevavn ihu, vela yifgeu lon hacha.

Amar ribbi yehuda leribbi chizkiyya, ha chamena deribbi yose dachil ihu, i tema begin deihu chattaa. dechol man dedachil, chattaa ihu. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:14) pachadu vetziyyon chattaim, ha lav ihu chattaa, (veha) uchetiv, (Mishlei 28:1) vetzaddikim kichfir yivtach. amar ribbi yose, begin denizka shechiach.

Amar leh, i nizka shechiach, hachi hu. aval hacha la ishtakkach nizka. ulevatar deanan niol limarta, la leul nizka letzaara lan. alu limarta, amar ribbi yehuda, niflog lelya litlat mishmarot dehave lelya, kol chad vechad minnan, lekum al kiyyumeh, behanne telat sitre lelya vela nidmuch.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar, (Tehillim 89:1) maskil leetan haezrachi, hay tushebachta, avraham avinu amarah, beshata deishtaddal befulechana dekudesha berich hu, veavid chesed im bene alma, deyishtemodun kolla lekudesha berich hu, dekudesha berich hu shallit al ara veikre etan. begin deatkif bitkifu beh bekudesha berich hu.

Chasde Adonai olam ashira, vechi missitra dachasidim atyayn lezammera, ella hacha itkelil sitra dismala bimina, veal da kudesha berich hu nasse leavraham, uvachen leh. veha ittemar deyitzchak bar telatin usheva shenin hava behahu zimna. may nissa et avraham, nissa et yitzchak mibbae leh. ella nissa et avraham, deyishtakkach bedina, uleitkelala bedina, deyishtakkach shelim kedka yeut. veal da chasde Adonai olam ashira.

Davar acher chasde Adonai olam ashira, inun chasadim dekudesha berich hu avid im alma. (Tehillim 89:2) ledor vador odia emunatcha befi, tivu ukeshot deavid im kolla. ledor vador odia emunatcha, da mehemnuta dekudesha berich hu deoda avraham bealma, veadkar leh befuma dechol biryayn. veal da odia emunatcha befi.

Vekudesha berich hu oda leh leavraham raza dimhemnuta, vechad yada raza dimhemnuta, yada deihu ikara vekiuma dealma, divgineh itbere alma, veitkeyyaym. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:3) ki amarti olam chesed yibbane vegomer. dechad bara kudesha berich hu alma, chama dela yachil lemekam, ad deoshit yemina aleh veitkeyyaym. vei lav deoshit yemina aleh, la itkeyyaym. begin dealma da bedina itberi, veha okimna.

Veittemar bereshit, veraza kelala chada, teren gevavnin hacha, bereshit, af al gav deamaran sheruta mittatta leela, reshit hachi name meela letatta, vekaamrinan 2 reshit, kidkaamrinan bet kodesh hakkodashim, dehay ityeyhivat lehahu reshit, umilla kelila ihi kechada.

Uvehay 412 itbere alma da, vela itkeyyaym ella bimina. veha ukemuha. behibbaram, beavraham ketiv. uvegin kach, amarti olam chesed yibbane. uvinyana kadmaa dealma (hahu olam), hahu nehora deyoma kadmaa, hava beh lekayyma. ulevatar beyoma tinyayna, bismala. uvehanhu atkin shamayim. uchetiv, shamayim tachin emunatcha bahem.

Davar acher, shamayim tachin emunatcha bahem, shamayim beinun chasadim ittaknu, veraza deemuna atkanat behu, delet tikkunaha ella miggo shamayim. (Tehillim 89:4) karatti berit livchiri, da hu raza dimhemnuta.
460: Tzaddik demineh nafkin birchan lechullehu tattae, vechol (inun) chevavn kaddishan, kullehu itbarchan, min hahu negidu denagid letattay, uvegin kach ketiv, karatti berit livchiri.

(Tehillim 89:4) nishbati ledavid avdi, da raza dimhemnuta, deihu kayyma tadir betzaddik da. kiyyuma dealma, dela yitbadderun lealmin, bar bezimna degaluta, dingidu devirchan itmenau. veraza dimhemnuta la ishtallim, vechol chedvavn itmenau. vechad ayil lelya, mehahu zimna, chedvavn la alu kamme malka.

Veaf al gav dechedvavn la itaru, aval levar kayyme umezammere shirata. vechad itpelig lelya, veitaruta salka mittatta leela, keden kudesha berich hu atar kol chele shemaya livchiya, uvaat birkia, veizdazean illae vetattae.

Velet nayycha kammeh, bar bezimna demitare letatta beorayyta. keden, kudesha berich hu vechol inun nishmatin detzaddikaya (deimmeh), kullehu tzayytin vechadyayn lehahu kala ucheden nayycha. (sefer acher kammeh veate nayycha lechullehu nishmatin detzaddikayya immeh) (kammeh ishtechach). begin demiyyoma deitchariv makdesha letatta, ome kudesha berich hu, dela yeul bego yerushelem dilela, ad deyaalun yisrael liyrushalam diltatta. dichtiv, (Hoshea 11:9) bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir, veha ukemuha chavrayay.

Vechol inun mezammere, kayyme levar, veamre shirata, bitlat palge lelya vechullehu meshabbechan betushebachtan yedian, vechullehu chele shemaya, kullehu mitare belelya, veyisrael bimama. ukedusha la mekaddeshe leela, ad dimkaddeshe yisrael letatta, ucheden kol chele shemaya mekaddeshe shema kaddisha kechada. veal da yisrael kaddishin, mitkaddeshin meillae vetattae (sefer acher begin dikdushsha dishma dekudesha berich hu lo salik ella meella umittatta) kechada. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Iyov 38:6) al ma adaneha hatbau, hay kera kudesha berich hu amar leh, begin dechad bara alma, la vara leh ella al samchin, deinun 7 samchin dealma. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 9:1) chatzva ammudeha shiva, veinun samchin la ityeyda al ma kayymin.

Begin deihu raza amika setima dechol setiman. vealma la itbere, ad denatal avna chada, veihu avna deitkere even shetiyya, venatal lah kudesha berich hu, vezarak lah lego tehoma, veitneitz meela letatta, uminneh ishtil alma. veihi nekuda emtzaita dealma, uvehay nekuda kayyma kodesh hakkodashim. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:6) o mi yara even pinnatah. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan pinat yikrat. uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pina.

Ta chaze, hay even itkare meeshsha umerucha umimmaya, veitgelid mikkullehu, veitavid avna chada, vekayyma al tehome, ulezimnin navin minneh maya, veitmalyayn tehome. vehay avna kayyma leat beemtzaita dealma, vehay ihu even dekiyyem veashtil yaakov, shetilu vekiyyuma dealma. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 31:45) vayyikkach yaakov aven vayrimeha matztzeva.

Vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva vegomer, (Bereshit 28 22) vechi hay even shavve leh yaakov. veha hay even itbere bekadmita, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma. ella deshavve lah (nusach acher vechi hasheta shavvi leh yaakov. veha ad lo itbere alma hauot, ella deyaakov shavvi la) kiyyuma dilela vetatta, veal da asher samti matztzeva ketiv. may asher samti, dichtiv, yihye bet elohim, deshavve medora dilela hacha.

Ta chaze, hay even it alah shiva enayim. kema deat amer, (Zecharya 3:9) al even achat shiva enayim, al ma itkeriat shetiyay. chad deminnah ishtil alma. vechad, shetiyay. shat ya, deshavve kudesha berich hu lah, leitbarcha minnah alma, begin dealma minnah mitbarcha.

Veta chaze, beshata deal shimsha, hanne keruvim dekayymin behay ducheta, vehavu yatve beat, havu akshan gadfayyhu leel, ufarse lon, veishtema kol nigguna degadfayyhu leela, ucheden sharan lenagna inun malachin, deamre shirata besheruta delelya, begin disallak yekareh dekudesha berich hu, mittatta leela. umay shirata havu amru, hahu nigguna degadfayyhu dichruvim, (Tehillim 134:2) hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vegomer, seu yedechem kodesh vegomer, ucheden (inun) ihu shirata leinun malache illae lezammara.
461: Akshe gadfayyhu leela, veishtema kol nigguna dilhon, ucheden sharan lenagna inun malachin dekayymin bemishmarta tinyayna. umay shirata havu amre behay shata, nigguna degaddefayyhu dichruvim, (Tehillim 125:1) habbotchim baAdonai kehar tziyyon lo yimmot vegomer. ucheden (hahu) ihu (shirata) sheruta leinun dekayyme behay mishmara tinyayna lenagna.

Bemishmara telitaa, hanne keruvim akshu gadfayyhu veamre shirata, umay hi. (Tehillim 113:1-2) haleluya hallelu avde Adonai vegomer, yehi shem Adonai mevorach vegomer, mimmizrach shemesh vegomer. keden inun malachin dekayyme bemishmara telitaa, kullehu amre shirata.
