Vechullehu kochave umazzale devirkia patche shirata. kema dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim. uchetiv, (Tehillim 148:3) halleluhu kol kochve or, deha inun kochve dinhora, menagnan al nehora. (sefer acher dimmanan al shirata).

Kad ate tzafra, ucheden natle shirata abbatrayyhu deyisrael (sefer acher yisrael) letatta, vesalka yekareh dekudesha berich hu, mittatta umilleela. yisrael letatta bimama, umalache illae leela belelya, ucheden ishtelim shema kaddisha bechol sitrin.

Vehay even dekaamar, kullehu malache illae, veyisrael letatta, kullehu itkafu behay even, veihi salka leela, leitattera go avahan bimama. uvelelya, kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden.

Zakkain inun kol dekayyme bekiyyumayyhu, umishtaddelin beorayyta belelya. begin dekudesha berich hu vechol inun tzaddikayay divginta deeden, shamu kalayyhu divne nasha, inun demishtaddele beorayyta. kema dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim vegomer.

Ta chaze, hay even, ihu even tava. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 28:17) umilleta vo milluat even arbaa ture even. veillen inun sidrin (daashalemavetaa) deeven tava, ashlamuta deeven yekara. begin deit (ashlamuta) even ochora. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:26) vahasiroti et lev haeven vegomer. uchetiv, (Yechezkel 36:27) veet ruchi etten bekirbechem. vehay ihu (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan pinnat yikrat veukemuha.

Veal raza da ketiv, (Shemot lo) luchot haeven, deinun luchot itgezaru mehacha, veal da ikrun al shemeh dehay even. vehay hu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:24) mishsham roe even yisrael (sefer acher ha vadday even yisrael akeh) kema deittemar.

Patach ribbi chizkiyya veamar, (Shemot 28:21) vehaavanim tihyena al shemot beni yisrael shetem esre, illen avne yekarin illain, deitkarun avni hammakom, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavne hammakom. veha ukemuha. (Shemot 39:14 386) vehaavanim al shemot bene yisrael, kema deit (12 avanim) 12 shevatim letatta, hachi name leela teresar shivtin, veinun terisar avanin yakkirin, uchetiv, (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah (da raza) edut leyisrael, da yisrael, raza dilela. vechullehu lehodot leshem Adonai, veal da vehaavanim tihyena al shemot bene yisrael.

Uchema deit 12 shae bimama, hachi it 12 shae belelya, beyoma leela, belelya letatta, kolla da lokovel da, hanne 12 shae divlelya mitpallege litlat pelagan, vechamma memanne terisin kayyme techotayyhu, dargin al dargin, kullehu memannan belelya, venatle tarpa bekadmayta.

Ucheden kad itpelig lelya, kayymin teren (sitrin) sidrin missitra da, uteren sidderin missitra ochora, (sefer acher veda) verucha illaa nafak (sefer acher nashiv) benayyhu, ucheden kol inun illanin divginta deeden, kullehu patche shirata, vekudesha berich hu al beginta deeden. hada hu dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 17:16) az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai, ki va lishpot et haaretz. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:4) veshafat betzedek dallim. begin demishpat al benayyhu veitmalyay minnah (sefer acher minneh) gan eden.

Verucha detzafon itar bealma, vechedva ishtakkach venashiv hahu rucha beinun busemin, vesalkin rechin leela, umitatterin (sefer acher umitarin) tzaddikaya beitrayyhu, umithannan miggo ziva deaspaklarya denahara.

Zakkain inun tzaddikaya, dezachan lehahu nehora illaa, vehahu nehora deaspaklarya denahara, nahir lechol sitrin, vechol chad vechad meillen tzaddikaya, natil lechulakeh kedka chaze leh, vehava natil (sefer acher vehachi nahir) kol chad vechad kefum ovadoy deavad behay alma, (meinnun) it minnehon demitkasfe, mehahu nehiru denatil chavreh
462: Chulakeh delelya, mikkad share lelya lemeal. kamma gardine nimmusin mitarin, veshatan bealma, ufatchin (172 amud bet) setimin, ulevatar kamma zinin liznayyhu, kema deokimna. ucheden kad itpelig lelya, sitra detzafon nachit (nahir nehiru) meela letatta, veachid beh belelya, ad teren chulakin delelya.

Ulevatar sitra dedarom itar, ad deate tzafra. vechad ate tzafra, keden darom vetzafon achidu beh, ucheden atan yisrael letatta, salkin lah bitzlothon uvautehon leela, ad desalka veitgenizat benayyhu. venatla birchan meresha (demalka) dechol reshin.

Veitbarcha mehahu talla deitmashshecha milleela. umehahu talla parish lechamma sitrin, vechamma ravvavn ittezanu minneh mehahu talla, uminneh atidin laachayay metayay. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) hakitzu verannenu shochne afar ki tal orot talecha. talla meinun nehorin illain denaharin leela.

Ad dehavu yatve itpelig lelya, amar leh ribbi yehuda leribbi yose, hasheta rucha detzafon itar, velelya itpelag, vehasheta iddana dekudesha berich hu taiv lekalhon detzaddikaya behay alma, inun demishtaddele beorayyta. hasheta kudesha berich hu tzayyet (lekol millayyhu) lan behay atar, la nifsok mille deorayyta.

Patach veamar, hammalacha haggoel oti mikkol ra, ha ittemar veukemuha. aval ta chaze, ketiv, (Shemot 23:20) hinni anochi sholeach malach vegomer, da hu malach deihu paroka dealma, netiru divne nasha, vehay ihu deazmin birchan lechol alma, begin deihu natil lon bekadmita, vlvatar ihu azmin lon bealma. uvegin da ketiv, hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha. (Shemot 33:2) veshalachti lefanecha malach.

Vehay ihu malach dilzimnin dachar ulezimnin nukeva, vehachi ihu. debzimna deihu azmin birchan lealma (leella), keden ihu dachar, veikre dachar. kidchura deazmin birchan (letatta) lenukeva, hachi ihu azmin birchan lealma. uvezimna dekayyma bedina al alma, keden ikre nukeva. kenukeva deihi ubbara, hachi ihu itmele min dina, ucheden ikre nukeva. veal da lezimnin ikre dechura, ulezimnin ikre nukeva, vecholla raza chada.

Kegavvna da ketiv, (Bereshit 3:24) veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet, malachin it sheluchan bealma, demithappechin lechamma gevavnin, lezimnin nukeve, lezimnin dechure, lezimnin dina, lezimnin rachame, vecholla bechad gavvna. kegavvna da hay malach, bigvavnin saggiin ihu, vechol gevavnin dealma, kullehu itanhu behay atar. veraza da, (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem ken mare hannogga saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai. uchema deit beh kol inun gevavnin, hachi name anhig lechol alma:

Tosefta rechime illae, mare desuchletanu istakkalu, huremani yedian bekulepe desichta, kerivu leminda, man minnechon mare deayynin besuchletanu, veyada beshata desalik birutta deraza derazin, leappaka telatt gevavnin kechada kelilan, vinun, chivvavr vesumak vyarok, telatt goonin kechada ishtelivan da im da, mizdavvgan (sefer acher mazedalegan) da im da, magroppaya tattaa itztabba, vnappeka miggo goonin illen.

Vechol goonin illen, ittechazun behay. chezu ihu leistakkala, keena divdolcha ittechaze beshata. kegavvna devatash begavvav, hachi ittechaziyi levar. illen telatt goonin sacharan lehay, vegoona azla salka venachatta kistorin dekitra kevie begon (sefer acher begavvav).

Goonin sacharin (sefer acher gavvnin) kelilan kechada, salkin lah leela bimama, venachatta belelya. sheraga dedalik ittechaziyi belelya, bimama istattaratt nehora, temira bemattan vearbain uttemanya almin, kullehu azlin legavvav (sefer acher beginah) milleela letatta, go telatt mea veshittin vechamesh shayypin geniza vittekasya letatta.
463: Leashkacha lah, yittevar gadpin kelippin temirin, veyippetach tarin. man dezache lemecheme, yecheme go yedia vesuchletanu, keman dechame battar kottela. bar min moshe nevia mehemna illaa, dehava chame leh ena beena, leela beattar dela itteyyda.

Man dela zache, dachu leh levar, kamma chavile tehirin izdammenu legabbeh, izdammenan nappeke aleh, vappiku leh dela yistakkal beinnuga demalka. vavy lon leinun chayyayvin dealma, dela zachan leistakkala, kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 4:20) velo yavou lirott kevalla t hakkodesh vegomer.

Amar ribbi yehuda, mistakkel havena, veha miggo zehirin illen, mistakkelan nishmattehon detzaddikaya, kad ittedabbaku behay attar, miggo zehirin illen mistakkelin nishmattehon detzaddikaya. inun goonin, salkin veitteklilan kechada. zakkaa ihu man deyada leachlala uleyachada kullehu kechada, leattekana kolla beattar deitztericha leela leela, ucheden ittentir bar nash behay alma, uvealma deatte. (ad kan tosefta):

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Tehillim 99:4) veoz melech mishpat ahev atta konanta mesharim vegomer. veoz melech mishpat ahev, da kudesha berich hu. veoz melech, tukefa deatkif kudesha berich hu, lav ihu ella bemishpat, deha bemishpat itkeyyaym ara. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 29:4) melech bemishpat yaamid aretz.

Uvegin kach, veoz melech mishpat ahev, vela (ittakaf) ittakkanat keneset yisrael ela bemishpat, begin demittamman ittezanat, vechol birchan denatla, mittamman natla. uvegin kach veoz melech mishpat ahev, kol teivu, vechol rechimu dilah lokovel mishpat. atta konanta mesharim, raza (192 amud alef besitre tora) ditren keruvim letatta, deinun tikkuna veyishuva dealma, veha ittemar.

Ribbi (yitzchak) chizkiyya patach veamar, (Tehillim 135:1) hallelu yah hallelu avde Adonai hallelu et shem Adonai, hay kera it leistakkala beh, kevan deamar halleluya, ammay hallelu avde Adonai, ulevatar hallelu et shem Adonai. ella hachi taninan, man dimshabbach (lachada) leachara, itzterich leshabbacha leh kefum yekareh, uchefum yekareh hachi itzterich shivcheh, vetaninan man dimshabbach leachara, beshivcha delet beh, hu gale (galuta vesavav) genuteh, vetzave legallaa leh. veal da, man deavid hespeda al bar nash, itzterich kefum yekareh, vela yattir. demiggo shivcheh ate lignuteh, uvecholla shevacha itzterich kefum yekareh.
Ta chaze, haleluyah, hacha it shevacha illaa demare decholla. atar dela shalta beh ena leminda uleistakkala (sefer acher atar), deihu temira dechol temirin. uman ihu, 15. shema illaa al kolla.

Uvegin kach halleluyah, shevacha ushema kechada, kelilan kechada. vehacha satim milla deamar halleluyah, vela amar man halleluyah, leman amru hallelu, ella kema dey satim, hachi shevacha deshabbuche satim inun, dimshabbeche la yedana man inun, vehachi itzterich lemeheve kolla satim, beraza illaa. ulevatar desatim beraza illaa, galle veamar, hallelu avde Adonai hallelu et shem Adonai. begin deda ihu atar dela satim kehahu illaa temira dechol temirin. da hu atar deikre shem, kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 6:2) asher nikra sham shem Adonai.

Kadmaa satim dela (sefer acher da) galya, (tinyayna) satim vegalya, uvegin dekayyma beitgalleyay, amar inun deka meshabbeche lehahu atar, man inun. vekaamar deinun avde Adonai, deitchazzun leshabbacha leatar da.

Yehi shem Adonai mevorach, may shena dekaamar yehi. ella yehi, raza deamshachuta mehahu atar illaa, deihu satim dekaamaran, deihu 15, ad raza divrit, deihu yod tattaa, kegavvna deyud illaa, sheruta kesofa.

Uvegin kach yehi, raza deamshechuta mittemira dechol temirin, ad darga tattaa. uvemilla da itkeyyaym kol ovada divreshit. kema deat amer, (16 amud bet) yehi rakia, yehi meorot, yehi or. bechol inun ovadin dilela ketiv yehi.
Bechol inun ovadin diltatta, la ketiv yehi. begin deraza da deihu (sefer acher ameshakevatea) meraza illaa, setimin dechol setimin, la itkeyyaym ella bemillin illae dilela, vela ittemar beinun
464: Uveda mitbarach shema kaddisha becholla, veal da ketiv yehi shem Adonai mevorach vegomer, mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo, da atar illaa, deka nahir minneh shimsha, venahir lecholla. veda hu atar deresha illaa setimaa.

Vead mevoo, da hu atar kishra, deitkkashshar beh mehemnuta kedka chaze, umittamman nafkan birchan lecholla, vealma mehacha ittezan, kema deittemar. uvegin kach kayyma hay atar leittezana meela, uleitbarcha mittamman. vecholla kayyma beitaruta diltatta, demitare inun avde Adonai, kad mevarche shema kaddisha, kidkaamaran. vvgin kach deihu beitgalleyay, ketiv hallelu avde Adonai hallelu et shem Adonai.

Adhachi hava nahir tzafra, nafku min mearta, uvehahu lelya la demichu. azlu bearcha, kad nafku meinun turin, yatvu vetzallu tzelota. matu lechad kefar, veyatvu tamman kol hahu yoma, behahu lelya namu, ad dehava palgut lelya, kamu leitasseka beorayyta.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar vayvarachem bayyom hahu lemor becha yevarech yisrael vegomer, vayvarachem bayyom hahu, may bayyom hahu, deha sagge dekaamar vayvarachem. vetu, kol lemor ketiv chaser, vehacha lemor bevyv ketiv, (kelala ketiv lemor, ella 24 lemor ketiv hacha) may shena.

Ela raza ihu, vayvarachem bayyom hahu, may bayyom hahu, raza dedarga deitmanna al birchan leela. yom hahu, yom mehahu atar illaa, deikre hu. vehay yom hahu, delet piruda ben yom uven hu, uvechol atar hayyom hahu, da (hu) teren dargin (illain), darga illaa vetattaa deinun kechada.

Uvegin kach, kad baa yaakov levarcha livnoy deyosef, barich lon beyichuda dilela vetatta kullehu kechada, (sefer acher lemor beVav deitkelil vav benayyhu, al da yiched lon beyichuda dilella kullehu kachada) begin deyitkayyaym birchathon, ulevatar kalil kolla kechada. veamar, becha yevarech yisrael (lemor). may becha. vadday da raza deyichuda, bekadmita mittatta leela (sefer acher yom hahu mittatta leella), ulevatar nachit leemtzaita uletatta. lemor beVav ha emtzaita. ulevatar nachit letatta becha. vehachi hu yaot kedka chaze, mittatta leela umeela letatta.

Becha yevarech yisrael, may yisrael, yisrael sava. yevorach yisrael la ketiv, ella yevarech, deha yisrael natil birchan milleela, ulevatar ihu mevarech lecholla, behay darga tattaa dayyka, dekaamar becha yevarech yisrael lemor.

Yesimcha elohim keefrayim vechimnashshe, akdim leh leefrayim bekadmita, begin deefrayim al shema (deyosef) deyisrael ikre. mena lan. meha, dechad shivta deefrayim nafak, ad la ishtelim zimna deshibuda demitzrayim, dachaku shata venafku min galuta, kamu alehon sanehon uketalu lon. uchetiv, (Yechezkel 36) ben adam haatzamot haelle kol bet yisrael hemma. mashma dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36) kol bet yisrael hemma, veal da akdim leefrayim kodam menashshe. begin kach efrayim matuleh listar maarav, umatlanoy hava.

Ta chaze, bircheta devarich livne yosef, ammay akdim lon birchan, ad la yevarech livnoy. ella mikkan, dachavivuta divne benoy, chaviv aleh debar nash yattir mibbenoy. uvegin kach, akdim chavivuta divne benoy kodem livnoy, levarcha lon bekadmita.

Vayvarachem bayyom hahu lemor, ribbi yose patach veamar, (Tehillim 115:12) Adonai zecharanu yevarech yevarech et bet yisrael vegomer. Adonai zecharanu yevarech, illen guverin. yevarech et bet yisrael, illen nashin. begin didchurin bayayn leitbarcha bekadmita, ulevatar nashin, venashin la mitbarchan ela mibbirchathon didchurin, dechad dechurin mitbarchan keden nashin mitbarchan. vei tema meha, dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:6) vechipper baado uvead beto, devae lechappara aleh bekadmita, ulevatar al beteh, begin demitbarcha minneh.

Ta chaze, denashin la mitbarchan ella migguverin, kad itbarchan inun bekadmita, umehay birchata mitbarchan. ella bemay okimna yevarech et bet yisrael. ella kudesha berich hu yahav tosefet birchan lidchura denasiv, begin demitbarcha mineh itteta. vechen bechol atar
465: Yahiv kudesha berich hu tosefet birchan lidchura denasiv, begin demitbarcha (minneh itteta vechen bechol atar yahiv kudesha berich hu tosefet birchan lidchura denasiv, begin detitbarach minneh nukeba) mehahu tosefet devirchan. kevan deinsiv bar nash yahiv leh teren chulakin, chad leh vechad lenukeveh, veihu natil kolla, chulakeh vechulak nukeveh.

Ta chaze, vayvarachem bayyom hahu, (sefer acher lemor berich birchan lon ulechol deyifkun minnayyhu) levatar lemor beVav, hacha itremiza bera buchera, (Shemot 4) beni bechori yisrael, uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:9) veefrayim bechori hu, veal da tosefet vav.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Tehillim 139:16) galmi rau enecha veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu vegomer, hay kera ukemuha bechamma atar. aval ta chaze, kol inun nishmatin dehavu miyyoma deitbere alma, kullehu kayyme kamme kudesha berich hu ad la nachatu lealma, behahu diukena mammash deitchazun levatar bealma. vehahu chezu degufa devar nash dekaim behay alma, hachi kaim leela.

Uveshata denishmata da zemina laachata bealma, hahi nishmata behahi diukena mammash dekayyma behay alma, hachi kaim (leella) kamme kudesha berich hu, veome lah kudesha berich hu deyittor pikkude orayyta, vela yaavar al keyaymin.

Umena lan dekayymin kammeh, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:1) chay Adonai asher amadti lefanav. amadti vadday, veha ukemuha. uvegin kach galmi rau enecha, ad la yitchaze (tzulema) bealma. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, deha kol nishmatin, behahu diukena dilhon, kullehu besifra ketivin. yamim yutztzaru, ha ukemuha yutzaru vadday, velo echad bahem, behay alma lemekam bekiyyuma demarehon, kedka chaze.

Ta chaze, yomin debar nash, kad zache behay alma beovadin tavan, yomin dileh itbarchan leela, mehahu atar deihu middat yomoy. patach veamar, (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi vegomer, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, kitztzi, da ketz hayyamin, deihu mitkashshar beh bedavi 4. umiddat yamay ma hi, da ihu deitmanne (nusach acher deit memana) mammash al yomoy.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ha shamana meribbi shimon, dehay kera ittemar, al inun yomin deitgezaru aloy meadam kadmaa, deinun 70. deha ittemar, dechayyin kelal la havu leh, ella deyahiv leh adam meinun yomin dileh, shivin shenin.

Veraza da, vilon la meshamesh kelum, vesihara la naharat miggarmah kelal, veshivin shenin naharin lah bechol sitraha, veinun chayye david setam. veal da baa david lekudesha berich hu, leminda raza da, al ma let lah chayyin lesihara miggarmah, uleminda ikkara dilah.

Umiddat yamay ma hi, da hu darga (sefer acher dealma) illaa setima, deihu kayyma al kol inun yomin, deinun chayyin dilah, atar denahir lecholla. eda me chadel ani. amar david, inda al ma chadel ana nehora miggarmi, veitmena minni, kishar kol inun nehorain illain deit lon chayyin lechullehu, veana al ma ana chadel, veal ma itmena minni. veda hu devaa david leminda, vela ityeyhiv leh reshuta leminda.

Ta chaze, kol birchan illain, kullehu itmesaru lehay darga, levarcha lecholla. veaf al gav delet lah nehora miggarmah, kol birchan, vechol chedu, vechol tivu, kullehu kayymin bah, uminnah (kayyme) nafke, veal da itkeriat kos shel beracha. veikre beracha mammash, kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:22) birkat Adonai hi taashir, veal da ketiv, (Devarim 33:23) umale birkat Adonai yam vedarom yerasha.
Uvegin kach it lah bechullehu shiyyur, umikkullehu itmalyay, umikkullehu it bah, veitbarcha mikkol

Tosefta kal gilgela mitgalgela mittatta leella, rateykehaa taverakehaa azlin vametagelagelay. kal neimuta salleka venachta, azla veshatya bealma. kal shofara nagid baavamekay daderagey aschar darga (sefer acher gilgela) sacheranehaa.

Yatvin teren mageravepayn, mimina umissemala, bitren gavvnin mashetaabayn da beda, da chivvavr veda sumak, vetarvavyyhu sacharin gilgela leella, aschar limina chivvavra salleka, veaschar lismala sumeka nachta.
466: Inun birchan illain, veitmesaru lah birchan levarcha, menalan. deamar ribbi yitzchak, yaakov barich livnoy deyosef, meatar da dechol birchan itmesaru bideh levarcha, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 12) vehye beracha. mikkan ulehala birchan itmesaru beyadecha.

Ta chaze, kegavvna da anan mevarchan umeshabbechin lishma da, veal da hallela, deinun yomin dekaamre hallela. deamar ribbi chiyyay behallela tzerichin 3 dargin, chasidim, tzaddikim, veyisreelim. (sefer acher begin deyistelik yikkare dekudesha berich hu al kolla beillen dargin) chasidim, missitra dimina, tzaddikim missitra dismala, veyisrael mikkol inun sitrin, begin (dayshareym) deyisrael kelilan mikkullehu, veal da istallak tushebachta dekudesha berich hu mikkolla, vechen bechol atar deyisrael meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu mittatta, istallak yekareh becholla:

Teren (162 amud bet) tzipporin salkin, deka metztzappetztzepan, chad listar darom, vchad listar tzappon. parchin baavira tzippetztzuppa, vekal neimu degalgalla mittechabberan kechada, keden (Tehillim 92:1) mizmor shir leyom hashabbatt. vechol birchan nagdin bilchishu beda neimu (mikkol), miggo rechimu dekol shoppara.
Lekabbela inun birchan, nachattin milleela letatta, vittegnizu kechada bego (Shemot 63 amud bet) umeka devera, neviu devera dela paska bilchishu, ad deittemalyay hahu galgalla sachara.

Inun teren magroppin sacharan, chad dimina, kare vechayil vamar, zehiru dezaharin desalka vnachatta, tere alpe almin izdaharu. alma deemtztzaitta begavvavyyhu, izdahar bezohara demaracha. kol inun mare deayynin, istakkalu uppikchu enechon, vtizkun lehay nehiru, lehay idduna, illen inun birchan denagde milleela, man dezache, galgalla salka aschar limina, vangid vamshicha lehahu dezache, vitteaddan meillen birchan illain dezaharan, zakkain inun dezachan behu.

Vechad la zache, galgalla aschar, vhahu magroppa delistar semala, aschar vnachatt letatta, vamshicha dina al hay dela zache, vkala nappekatt, vavy leinun chayyayvin dela zachu. mehahu sitra, nappik esha deshalhova dedalik, deshare al reshehon dechayyayvaya. zakkain inun, kol inun daazlu beorach keshot behay alma, lemizke lehahu nehora illaa, birchan detztzachtztzechan, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 58:11) vhisbia betztzachtztzachott nappeshecha (74 kan tosefta):

Vayyikra yaakov el banav vayyomer heasfu vegomer, ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 102:18) pana el tefillat haarar velo baza et tefillatam. hay kera ukemuha, veakshu beh chavrayay. (ella tu it beh setar kaveradeytea) pana, hikshiv mibbae leh, o shama, may pana.

Ella kol tzelotin dealma tzelotin. utzelota deyachid, la al kamme malka kaddisha, ella bechela takkifa. dead la oolat hahi tzelota leitattera beduchetah, ashgach bah kudesha berich hu, veisteche bah, veisteche bechovoy uvizchuteh dehahu bar nash, ma dela avid ken bitzlota desaggiin. ditzlota desaggiin kamma inun tzelotin dela (mibbene) min zakkain inun, vealin kullehu kamme kudesha berich hu, vela ashgach bechovayyhu.

Vegin kach, pana el tefillat haarar, mehappech (bizchuteh) veisteche vah, veisteche bah bemma reuta itavid, uman hahu bar nash detzalle tzelota da, uman inun ovadoy. vegin kach, libbae leh lebar nash, diltzalle tzelota betzibbura. may tama, begin dela vaza et tefillatam, af al gav delav kullehu bechavvavna ureuta delibba.

Davar acher pana el tefillat haarar, da yechiday deitkelil besaggiin. uman hu yechiday deitkelil besaggiin, heve ema da yaakov, deihu kalil bitren sitrin, ukera livnoy, vetzalle tzeloteh alayyhu. man tzelota deyitkabbelun bishlimu leela, tzelota dela yishtetzun begaluta.

Behay shata deyaakov kara lon, istallak minneh shechinta, veha ukemuha. veta chaze, beshata deyaakov hava kare livnoy, izdammenu avraham veyitzchak tamman, ushechinta al gabbayyhu. ushechinta hava chade beh beyaakov, leitchabbera baavahan,
467: Leitkashshera im nafshayyhu kechad, lemehve reticha.

Beshata defatach yaakov, veamar heasfu veaggida lachem et asher yikra etchem beacharit hayyamim. beacharit, da shechinta, kivyachol yahav atzivu beh, veistallak. ulevatar ahadaru lah benoy, beyichude demilayyhu, ufatchu veamru, (Devarim 6) shema yisrael vegomer. behahi shata kaim lah yaakov, veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed, veityayshvat shechinta beduchetah. vayyikra yaakov, may keria hacha. ella keria, lekayyma duchetayyhu, lekayyma lon leela vetatta.

Ta chaze, bechol atar keria behay gavvna, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 13:16) vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua, lekayyma ducheteh, beatar deitzterich, ulekashra leh. vechen (Bereshit 25:26) vayyikra shemo yaakov. uchetiv, (Bereshit 33:20) vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael, kudesha berich hu kiyyem leh leatar da bishma da. keria lekiyyuma ka atya.

I tema (Yona 3:8) veyikreu el elohim, (Yona 2:3) karati mitztzara li el Adonai, hachi hu vadday, lekashra ulekayyma kiyyuma leela. uman ihu, siddura deshivcha demareh. vechol inun millin devaan kamme mareh, kiyyuma yahiv leh lemareh, deachaze deveh talya kolla, vela beatar ochora, ha kolla kayyaym kiyyuma. kehay gavvna vayyikra yaakov el banav, kiyyem lon bekiyyuma shelim. kegavvna da vayyikra el moshe, itkeyyaym bekiyyumeh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, 1 devayyikra, ammay hi zeera. amar leh, itkeyyaym moshe bishlimu, vela becholla, deha istallak meitteteh. besifre kadmae amre leshivcha, veanan hachi taninan, may deistallak leela, yitkashshar leela uletatta, ucheden, ihu shelim. tu, alef zeera meatar zeera hava, zeera deihu rav beitchabberuteh leela. (nusach acher leella vetatta ucheden shelim).

Vayyomer, may vayyomer. ha ukemuha, (kema deat amar, vayyomer belibbo) (Yeshayahu 49:21) veamarta vilvavecha, amira bachashay. heasfu, isfu mibbae leh, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 50:Adonai) isfu li chasiday. ella (sefer acher kayyim lon) kim lan heasfu meatar dilleela hu. heasfu bekishshura shelim beyichuda chad. veaggida lachem, may veaggida, raza dechachmeta ihu.

Ribbi yose shail leribbi shimon, amar leh, veaggida, o veyagged, o veyaggidu, vechen kullehu, detaninan deraza dechachmata ihi, ammay bemilla da (bechullehu) ihu raza dechachmeta. amar leh, begin deihu milla deatya begimel dalet bela piruda, vehay ihu raza dechachmata. milla deatya bishlimu beraza deatvavn, hachi hu, kad inun bechachmeta. aval dalet bela gimel, lav hu shelimu, vechen gimel bela dalet. deha da beda itkashsheru bela piruda, uman deafrish lon, garim legarmeh mota, veraza da chova deadam.

Vegin kach, hu milla deraza dechachmeta, veaf al gav deit yod lezimnin ben gimel ledalet, lav have piruda, vecholla kishshura chada, veal da milla da, hachi hu vadday. veaggida lachem, raza dechachmeta, baa legallaa sofa dechol ovadehon deyisrael.

Vei tema, dela gale may devaa legallaa, i hachi, ammay ketiv beorayyta milla deyaakov shelema, veitpegim levatar, vela ishtelim milla. ella vadday ishtelim, kol ma deitzterich legallaa galle vesatim, amar milla vegalle levar vesatim lego. umilla deorayyta la itpegim lealmin.

Vecholla hu satim beh beorayyta, begin deorayyta hu shelimu decholla, shelimu dilela vetatta, vela it milla o at beorayyta pegimu. veyaakov kol ma deitzterich leh lememar amar, aval galle vesatim, vela pagim mikkol ma devaa afillu ot achat.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yose havu yatve yoma chad afitcha delod. amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda, ha dechaminan deyaakov barich livnoy, chaminan mimma dichtiv, vayvarech otam, aval an birchata dilhon. amar leh, kolla birchan inun devarich lehu. kegon, yehuda atta yoducha achecha. dan yadin ammo. measher shemena lachmo. vechen kullehu.
Aval ma devae legalle lon la galle, devaa legallaa lehu et hakketz. veha ukemuha, deit ketz limina, veit ketz lismala, uvaa legallaa lon et hakketz, begin leistammera
468: Uleitdakkea mearla. vman degalle lon ityeda veitgalle, ad dealu leara kaddisha. aval millin ochoranin lav inun beitgalleyay, usetimin inun beorayyta, behay parshata deyaakov, uveinun birchan.

Patach veamar. reuven bechori atta kochi vereshit oni. may ka chama yaakov lemiftach biruven, liftach bihuda, deihu kadmaa lechol mashshiryayn, veihu malka, vechaminan dela barcheh vesalik birchan minneh, ad deata moshe vetzalle tzelota aleh. kema deat amer, (Devarim 33:6) yechi reuven veal yamot.

Aval vadday barcheh, vesalka hahu bircheta leatreh. levar nash dehava leh bar, kad mata zimneh leistalleka mealma, ata malka aleh, amar, ha kol mamona dili, lehve bida demalka natir livray. kad chame malka divri itchaze, yahiv leh. kach yaakov amar. reuven bechori atta, rechima demeayy ant, aval birchan dilach yistallekun bida demalka kaddisha, ad deyechome vach, begin deazalt lokovel appach vegomer, ketargumo:

Reuven bechori atta vegomer. ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Yechezkel 37:9) vayyomer elay hinnave el haruach vegomer. kamma atimin inun bene nasha, dela yadin vela mashgichin bikara demalka, deha orayyta achriz alayyhu bechol yoma, velet man detzayyit udeneh lekovleh. hay kera kashya, kevan dichtiv hinnave el haruach, ammay zimna ochora hinnave ben adam veamarta el haruach.

Ella mikkan olifna raza dechachmeta, teren kayymin hacha, chad leitara mittatta leela. dei la mitarin letatta, la mitarin leela, uveitaruta diltatta itar leela. hinnave el haruach mittatta leela. hinnave ben adam veamarta el haruach, meela letatta.

Deha afillu leela, beitaruta diltatta, nakit hahu illaa meillaa minneh. kegon hay kera, (Yechezkel 37:9) ko amar Adonai mearba ruchot boi haruach, mearba ruchot, da darom umizrach vetzafon umaarav, veruach atya mimmaarav, beitchabberuta deillen ochoranin. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 21:18) karuha nedive haam vegomer.

Umehacha nafkin ruchin venishmatin livne alma leitztayyra behu. ufache, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim. ta chaze, nakit mehay gisa, veyahiv begisa ochora, veal da (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam ennnu male. ammay enennu male, begin denakit veyahiv, ail veappik.

Ribbi elazar shail sheelta leribbi shimon. amar, hoil vekudesha berich hu gale kammeh divne nasha yemutun, ammay nachit nishmatin lealma, veammay itzterich leh. amar leh, sheelta da kammayyhu derabbanan sheilu chamma vechamma, veukemuha. aval kudesha berich hu yahiv nishmatin denachatin lehay alma, leishtemoda yekareh, venakit lon levatar, i hachi ammay nachatu.

Ella, raza da, hachi hu. patach veamar, (Mishlei Adonai:15) shete mayim mibborecha venozlim mittoch beerecha, ha (60 amud alef) okimna. bor, atar dela nevia miggarmeh, veematay navin hanne maya, beshata deishtelim nishmata behay alma, kad salka lehahu atar deitkashshar beh, keden hu shelim, mikkol sitrin mittatta umeela. (sefer acher umikkol sitrin).

Vechad nishmata salka, keden itar tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura, ucheden navin maya mittatta leela. uvor, itavid beer, mayin nevian. ucheden itchabberuta veyichuda (nusach acher visoda) vetiuveta veraava ishtakkach. (leha) deha benishmata detzaddika ishtelim hahu atar, veitar chavivuta ureuta leela, veitchabbar kechad.

Reuven bechori atta, hachi hu vadday, tippa kadmaa deyaakov hava, ureuteh beatar ochora hava kema deittemar. ta chaze, reuven vechullehu shivtin teresar, kullehu itachadan bishchinta, vechad chama yaakov lishchinta al gabbeh, kara livnoy teresar leitchabbera bah.
Veta chaze, arsa shelemata la ishtakkach min yoma deitbere alma, kehahi shata devaa
469: Yaakov leistalleka mealma, avraham mimineh, yitzchak mismaleh, yaakov hava shachiv benayyhu, shechinta kammeh. kevan dechama yaakov chach, kara livnoy, veachid lon sacharaneh dishchinta, vesidder lon besiddura shelim.

Mena lan desidder lon sacharaneh dishchinta, dichtiv heasfu, ucheden ishtakkach tamman shelimu decholla, vechamma retichin illain sacharanayyhu. patche veamre, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vegomer, keden itkenish shimmesha legabbeh desihara, veitkeriv mizrach bemaarav. hada hu dichtiv vayyeesof raglav el hammitta, veitnehir sihara, veishtakkach bishlimu. ucheden vadday taninan, yaakov avinu la mit. kevan dechama yaakov (sefer acher siddura) sitra shelim, ma dela ishtakkach hachi levar nash ochora, chade, veshabbach leh lekudesha berich hu, ufatach uvarich livnoy, kol chad vechad kedka yeut leh.

Ribbi yose veribbi yesa havu azle bearcha. amar ribbi yiyisa ha vadday taninan, kol benoy deyaakov ittakkanu besiddura shelim, veitbarchu kol chad vechad kedka yeut leh, may ka nema behay kera, dichtiv, measher shemena lachmo vegomer. amar leh, la yedana, begin dela shamana beh mibbutzina kaddisha, ella ant veana nezil legabbe butzina kaddisha. azle, kad matu legabbe deribbi shimon, amru milla veshailu sheilta. amar lon, vadday raza dechachmeta hu.

Patach veamar, (Shoftim Adonai:17) asher yashav lechof yammim veal mifratzav yishkon, ammay yativ tamman. ella man deyativ besifta deyamma, ishtammesh betafnuke alma. (vehacha asher da pitcha illaa detzaddik 1 kad itbarcha learka birchan bealma. sefer acher vehacha samach lehay kera, measher, shemone lefitcha illaa demittamman aterakev birchan lealma) vehay pitcha ishtemoda tadir birchan dealma veikre asher, veda hu ammuda meinun dekaim alma alayyhu.

Vehahu atar deikre lechem oni, mehahu atar atkin (hahu). hada hu dichtiv measher shemena lachmo, ma dehava lachma demiskena, ithaddar lechem (avoni) pannag (shemone). begin dearik vearme beh birchan vetafnukin, vesofa dikra ochach, vehu yitten maadanne melech. man melech, da keneset yisrael, deminnah ittezan betafnuke alma. veda yahiv lehay melech kol birchan, kol chedu vechol tivu. hu yahiv uminna nafke. amru, i la atena lealma, ella leminda da, tav lan.

Reuven buchera deyaakov hava, amar ribbi chiyyay, leh hava itchaze kolla, veitavar minah kolla, veityehiv malchu lihuda, becheruta leyosef, kehunnata lelevi. hada hu dichtiv, pachaz kammayim al totar, la tishtaar behu. uma deamar kochi vereshit oni, hacha barcheh ufakdeh lekudesha berich hu.

Lirchima demalka, (devaa min malka lemebad beh tivu) (nusach acher dehava leh bara vahava bae demalka yabed leh tivu) yoma chad aavar bereh beshuka, amar lemalka, da hu beri, vadday rechima denafshay. shama malka, veyada deha shail al bereh. kach yaakov amar, reuven bechori atta kochi vegomer, hacha fakdeh lemalka.

Pachaz kammayim al totar, hacha amar ma deiara leh, dela ishtaar (leh) beara, veshade leh levar meara. lokovel da, chad memanna (techuma) missitra demishkena leela, di memanna techot yada demichael, veamre lah techot yeda degavriel. umichael hu resha bechol atar missitra dechesed, vegavriel missitra dismala digvura. (Hoshea 12:1) vihuda od rad im el, setar gevura, be dina ikre, vesamich leh reuven, af al gav demalchu hava dihuda, reuven samuch lekovleh hava.

Amar rabbi shimon, zeminin inun bene reuven, laagacha teren keravin bego ara. ta chaze, ketiv kochi, begaluta demitzrayim. vereshit oni, deinun havu kadmain legabbe achuhon likrava. yeter seet, legaluta deashshur, demittamman galu bene gad uvene reuven kadmay mikkullehu, vesavle kamma bishin, vechamma innuyin savlu, vela tavu ad kean.
Veyeter az, lezimna demalka meshicha yitar bealma, inun yifkun veyigchun keravin bealma, vinatzchun, veyittakfun al ammaya. uvene alma yidchalun minnayyhu veyirtetun kammayyhu,
470: Veyachshivu leitgabbera bemalchuta, vela yishtaarun beh. hada hu dichtiv pachaz kammayim al totar, may tama la yishtaarun beh, veafillu besitra chad dealma, begin ki alita mishkeve avicha. dizminin leaala uleaggacha keravin bego ara kaddisha, mishkeve avicha dayyka, zo yerushalem.

Ta chaze, bearba sitre alma, itbadderu bene reuven begaluta, lekivlehon dechol yisrael, deitgalu begaluta arba zimnin bearba sitre alma. hada hu dichtiv, kochi chad, vereshit oni tere, yeter seet telat, veyeter az arbaa. kegavvna da zeminin inun laagacha kerava bearba sitre alma, ulemishlat bekirbayyhu al kolla, vinatzchun amamin saggiin, veyishletun alayyhu:

Pachaz kammayim al totar ki alita mishkeve avicha, hacha itremiz al hirhura kadmaa dehava leh leyaakov. behay tippa kadmaa berachel, deilmale hirhura dehahi tippa hava beatrah, ishtaar reuven becholla. aval pachaz kammayim al totar ki alita mishkeve avicha, alita, behirhura ochora, az chillalta vegomer.

Davar acher, pachaz kammayim al totar, deha kad yigchun kerava beni reuven bealma, vinatzchun amamin saggiin, la yishtaarun bemalchuta, may tama, ki alita mishkeve, dizminin laagacha kerava beara kaddisha dayyka, dichtiv ki alita mishkeve avicha (sefer acher da yerushalayim. mishkeve), mishkav mibbae leh. ella, avicha da yisrael sava, mishkeve avicha vela mishkav, begin deha bitre zimne itbene yerushala 40, utelitaa lezimna demalka meshicha. veal da mishkeve avicha. vehacha itgalleyay beracha, umay dehava behahu zimna, umay dehava kad alu yisrael leara, uma diyhe bezimna demalka meshicha beovada diruven:

Shimon velevi achim, amar ribbi yitzchak, hacha achid lon besitra semala dishchinta. dechama ovadin dedina kashya, dela yachil alma lemisbal. amar ribbi yose, bircheta dilhon an hi. amar ribbi yitzchak, shimon la itchaze lehay, dechama leh kamma ovadin bishin. velevi deate missitra dedina kashya, uvircheta la talya beh. veafillu kad ata moshe, la tale birchateh beh. dichtiv, (Devarim 33:11) barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze, bekudesha berich hu talyay.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Tehillim 104:25) ze hayyam gadol urechav yadayim sham remes veen mispar chayyot ketannot im gedolot. ze hayyam gadol, da shechinta dekayyma aleh deyaakov kad baa leistalleka mealma. urechav yadayim, deha kol alma imle veishtelim veittzamtzem tamman. sham remes veen mispar, dechamma malache illae vekaddishae ishtakkechu tamman. chayyot ketannot im gedolot, illen inun 12 shevatin, benoy deyaakov, deishtakkachu behon bishlimu. chad ayyala, vechad zeev, vechad ari, vechad tale. amar ribbi yitzchak, arye chad, vetale chad, chad zeev, vechad gedi, vechen kullehu, leishtakkecha chayyot ketannot im gedolot.

Ribbi yehuda amar, kullehu shappir. aval yehuda arye, shimon shor, veha ukemuha chavrayay dehavu mashgichin da lokovel da, da mimina, veda mismala. letora deovadoy bishin, amru netzayyer ikkunin dearye bekofteh, veyistakkel beda veyidchal minneh, kach shimon shor, yehuda arye.

Shimon la zacha levirchan, ella tafal leh moshe bihuda. ketiv hacha (Devarim 33:7) shema Adonai kol yehuda, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 29:33) ki shama Adonai ki senua anochi. amar ribbi yehuda, shimon velevi, avuhon salik lon lemoshe. amar leh ribbi yose, may tama avuhon salik lon lemoshe. amar leh, af anan naslik leh levutzina kaddisha illaa.

Atu shaalu leh leribbi shimon. amar, kamma chavivin millin. atfach bidoy uvacha, amar man yegalle lach mehemna kaddisha, istallakt bechayyaych al bene nasha, istallakt bemotach, veastim deyukenach. mappetchan demarach itmasru bidach tadir.
Ta chaze, yaakov hava leh arba nashin, veolid benin mikkullehu,
471: Veistallik (nusach acher veishtelim) binshoy. kad baa yaakov leistallaka, shechinta kayyme aloy, baa livruche leillen, vela yachil, mikkamme shechinta dedachil. amar, hech aavid, deha tarvavyyhu missitra dedina kashya ka atyayn. i atkif bishchinta la yachilna, deha arba nashin havu li, veishtallimna behon. ella asallek lon lemare deveta, deha (beh) beta biruteh kayyma, uma devae yaavid.
Kacha yaakov amar, chulakin dinshin uvenin ha nasvit behay alma, veishtallammena, hech atkif bematronita yattir, ella asallek millin lemare matronita, vehu yaavid ma devae, vela yidchal.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Devarim 33:1) vezot habberacha asher berach moshe ish haelohim, mareh deveta, mareh dematronita. kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 30:14) ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu. deha (Bamidbar 7:1) kallot moshe ketiv. veal da, moshe barich man devaa vela dachil, kidokimna. uvegin kach amar yaakov, ha chamenan devanay illen besitra dedina kashya, (leteh) yete marih deveta vivarech lon.

Moshe vadday ish haelohim haya, ureuteh avid beveteh, kema deat amer ishah yekimennu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 10:35) vayyomer moshe kuma Adonai. veishah yeferennu. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 10:36) uvenucho yomar shuva Adonai. vadday reuteh avad mareh deveta velet deyimche viddeh. kevar nash degazar al inteteh, veavda reuteh. veal da yaakov af al gav dehava achid beilana dechayye, la hava mare deveta, ella letatta, moshe hu leela, begin kach salik lon lemareh deveta:

Besodam al tavo nafshi vegomer, ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav vegomer. sod Adonai lireav, raza illaa deorayyta, la yahiv kudesha berich hu ella leinun dachalay chattaa. uman deinun dachale chattaa, itgeli lon raza illaa deorayyta. uman ihu raza illaa deorayyta, heve ema da at kayyayma kaddisha, deikre sod Adonai berit kodesh.

Shimon velevi, atrechu garmayyhu al hay sod, beanshe shechem, deyigzerun garmayyhu vikabbeloy alon hay sod. ukera ashid, bemirma. tu beovada dezimri ben salu, defasal hay sod. veyaakov amar besodam al tavo nafshi. may nafshi. da nafsha deoolat veitachadat bivrit illaa leela, veikre nefesh tzerora dechayye.

Bikhalam al techad kevodi. ha ukemuha, kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 16:19) vayyakhel alehem korach. al techad kevodi, da kevod yisrael setam. veal da la barich lon avuhon, begin desalik lon lemoshe. ribbi chiyyay amar, mehanne kerae (chaser) (uvegine kach) (sefer acher mashma) dela itachid da beda, veitzterich hachi. veal da it beh kolla, velet lach dara bealma, dela nachata dina dillehon lekatrega bealma veasgiu mehaddere al petachayyhu divne nasha, he lach kolla. (sefer acher ha lekabbel ha):

Yehuda atta yoducha achecha yadcha beoref oyvecha vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 104:19) asa yareach lemoadim vegomer. asa yareach begin lekaddesha beh resh yarchin, veresh shattin. ulealmin sihara la nahir ella mishshimsha, vechad shimsha shallit, sihara la shalta. kad itkenish shimsha, keden sihara shalta, velet chusheban lesihara ella kad itkenish shimsha.

Vetarvavyyhu avad kudesha berich hu leanhara. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al haaretz vegomer. vehayu leotot, illen shabbatot, dichtiv, (Shemot 31:13) ki ot hi. ulemoadim, inun yomin tavin. uleyamim, illen reshe yarchin. uleshanim, illen rishe shenin. delehvon ummot haolam avdin chushban leshimsha, veyisrael lesihara.

Veazla ha, ki ha deamar ribbi elazar, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 9:2) hirbita haggoy lo higdalta hassimcha. hirbita haggoy, illen yisrael, dichtiv behu (Devarim 4:7) ki mi goy gadol. uchetiv, (divrei hayamim 1 17:21) goy echad baaretz. lo, begineh. higdalta hassimcha (mammash), da sihara, deitreviat binhora beginehon deyisrael. ummot haolam leshimsha, veyisrael lesihara, he minnayyhu adif. vadday sihara
472: Leela, veshimsha deummot haolam, techot hay sihara hu, vehahu shimsha mehay (sefer acher sitra) sihara nahir. chame ma ben yisrael, lehu. yisrael achidu besihara, veishtalleshlu beshimsha illaa, veitachadu beatar (beh) (sefer acher denahir leshammasha) dinhira meshammesha illaa, umitdabbekan beh, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Yehuda atta vegomer. ribbi shimon amar, malchu lihuda itkeyyaym, vehayeynu deamrinan, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:35) happaam ode et Adonai, begin deihu reviaa, ode et Adonai, begin deihu ragla reviaa lecharseya. Yahu, da reshima dishma illaa, uvemma ishtelim, beHei (sefer acher 436), vehayeynu hei batraa dishma kaddisha. shema kaddisha shelim beatvoy, vekesher deachid lon, al da yoducha achecha, demalchu lach itchazya leitkayyma vaday. (Hoshea 12:1) vihuda od rad im el veim kedoshim neeman, man kedoshim, illen kedoshim elyonin, dechullehu odan legabbeh, veshavyuha neeman, begin kach hu kadmaa bechola, hu malka al kolla.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Tehillim 45:14) kol kevudah bat melech penima. kol kevudah, da keneset yisrael, kevudah, begin deihu kavod, da al da, da dachar, veda nukeva (sefer acher da nukeba), veitkere kevudah. bat melech, hayeynu bat sheva, bat kol deihu kol gadol, vehay melech illaa hu. penima, begin deit melech delav ihu lego kavvavteh, vehay kevudah bat melech.

Mimmishbetzot zahav levushah, begin deitlabbeshat veitachadat bigvurata illaa, vehay, uf name melech ikre, uveginah kayyma ara. ematay, beshata deitachadat bemishpat. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 29:4) melech bammishpat yaamid aretz. veda karenan malchu dishmaya, vihuda itachid bah, veyarit malchuta divara.

Ribbi (abba) yehuda veribbi yitzchak havu kaazle bearcha. amar ribbi yitzchak, niftach bemille deorayyta venizil. patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Bereshit 3:24) vaygaresh et haadam vayyashken mikkedem legan eden vegomer. hay kera ukemuha chavrayay. aval vaygaresh, kebar nash degarish leinteteh, et haadam dayyka.

Ta chaze, raza demilla, adam bemma dechata ittefas, vegarim mota leh ulechol alma, vegarim lehahu ilana dechata beh teruchin, leittarcha beh, uleittarcha bivnoy lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, vaygaresh et haadam, et dayyka, kema dichtiv, (yeshaya 7) vaere et Adonai. uf hachi et haadam.

Vayyashken mikkedem legan eden vegomer, hay letatta. uchema dichruvim leela, it keruvim letatta, vehay ilana ashre alayyhu. veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet, inun tafse deshallehove deeshsha, mehahu charba demitlahata. hammithappechet, da hay charba, deyanka bitren sitrin, veithappecha missitra da lesitra ochora. davar acher hammithappechet, da lahat inun tafse deshallehova (sefer acher demalchuta) dekaamaran, demithappechan lezimnin guverin ulezimnin nashin, umithappechan midduchetayyhu lecholla. vechol da, lishmor et derech etz hachayyim. man derech, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech.

Amar ribbi yehuda shappir, vehachi hu vadday, degarim adam lehahu ilana dechata beh leittarcha, veafillu shear bene alma name, kema deat amer, (yeshaya 2) uvefishechem shullecha immechem, aval shappir kaamart, deha midducheteh mashma, dichtiv vaygaresh et haadam, begin deda shelimu deadam hu.

Umehahu yoma itpegim sihara, ad deata noach veal betiuveta (nusach acher betevuta). atu chayyayvaya veitpegim. ad deata avraham (veitkayymu), vekayyma bishlimu deyaakov uvenoy. veata yehuda veachid beh, veitkaf bemalchuta, veachsin leh achsanat almin, hu vechol benoy batroy, hada hu dichtiv, yehuda atta yoducha achecha. (sefer acher begin dedileh malchuta alayyhu, kema deat ameraz, 2 ki yehuda gevar beachiv, yoducha achicha) vadday beshata dekayymu yisrael al yamma, dechullehu odu leh, venachatu avatreh beyamma.

Yadcha beoref oyvecha, kema deat amer, (Shoftim 1:2) yehuda yaale (battechilla). yishtachau lecha bene avicha, kelala dechol inun shear shivtin, begin da beni avicha, vela bene immecha. bene avicha, ha kullehu shear shivtin, deaf al gav (bassefarim yeshanim deinnun atepaleygev) deitpelig litren malkevavn, kad havu salkin liyrushala 40, havu segidin vecharan lemalka deviyrushala 40, begin demalchuta diyrushala 40,
473: Yishtachavu lecha, vela ketiv veyishtachavu, dei ketiv veyishtachavu, leosafa lishar ammin. veyishtachavu la ketiv, ella bezimna deyete malka meshicha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:7) sarim veyishtachavu, hasheta deamar yishtachavu, leachazaa deyisrael kullehu bilchodayyhu, kullehu yiflechun leresha degola, lerosh devavel, vela shear ammin:

Gur arye yehuda, bekadmita gur, ulevatar arye, veraza demilla bekadmita naar, ulevatar ish, (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. mitteref beni alita, may mitteref. leachlala malach hammavt, deihu kayyma al teref, leshetzaa bene alma, vela meshezziv. kema deat amer, (Micha Adonai:7) vetaraf veen matztzil. (umahu) umehahu teref istallekat shechinta.

Kara, begaluta devavel. ravatz, begaluta deedom. kearye, deihu takkifa. uchelavi, deihu takkifa yattir. kach yisrael takkifin inun. divne alma ovde kochavim umazzalot mefattin vedachakin lon, veinun kayyme bedatehon uvenimusehon kearye uchelavi.

Kach shechinta, deaf al gav dichtiv, (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael, hi takkifa kearye uchelavi behay nefila. ma arye velavi la naflin, ella begin lemitraf tarpa uleshalletaa, deha merachik arach tarpeh, umishata dearach nafal, vela kam ad dedalig al tarpeh veachil lah. kach shechinta la nafla ella kearye uchelavi, begin lenakma meammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, uledallega alayyhu. kema deat amer, (yeshaya 63) tzoe berov kocho.

Mi yekimennu, hu la yakum lenakma minnayyhu nukema zeera, ella mi yekimennu. mi, kema deat amer, (Micha 2) mi yirpa lach, vehu ihu alma illaa, deveh shaltanuta leittakfa lecholla. uchetiv, (Iyov 38:29) mibbeten mi yatza hakkerach veukemuha:

Lo yasur shevet mihuda vegomer, ukemuha chavraya, aval ad ki yavo shilo beHei, begin deshar bev, leachazaa hacha raza (hacha) dishma kaddisha 15, beatar ochora shilo bela Adonai, beatar ochora shillo bela 10, vehacha shil beYod hei, raza dishma kaddisha illaa, dishchinta takum bishma (sefer acher da) dey veihu raza dey (sefer acher 50), kidkaamrinan.

Osri laggefen iro velassoreka beni atono vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 121:7) Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra yishmor et nafshecha, kevan deamar Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra, ammay yishmor et nafshecha. ella Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra, behay alma. yishmor et nafshecha behahu alma.

Shemira dehay alma hu, lemehve natir bar nash mikkamma zinin bishin mekatregin, deazlin lekatrega beni nasha bealma, uleitdabbeka behu. behahu alma may hu, kema deamaran. kad nafik bar nash mehay alma, i ihu zache, nishmata dileh salka veitatterat beatreh. vei la, kamma chavilin terikin izdammenan, leingeda leh laggehinnom, uleimsera leh bida deduma, deitmassera limmanna al gehinnom, utelesar elef ribbo memannan immeh, vechullehu izdammenan al nafshayyhu dechayyayvaya.

Ta chaze, shiva madorin it be baggehinnam, veshiva pitchin. venishmata dechayyayvaya alat, vechamma terikin, tehirin, neture tare, vealayyhu chad memanna bechol tara vetara, venishmathon dechayyayvaya itmasrun leinun memannan, al yeda deduma. kevan deitmasseran bidayyhu, satmin tarin deeshsha dimlahata.

Deha tarin batar tarin havu, tarin kullehu petichin usetimin, inun dilvar petichin, dilgo setimin. uvechol shabbat veshabbat kullehu petichin, venafkin chayyayvaya ad inun pitchin dilvar, ufagin nishmatin ochoranin, demitakkevin befitchin dilvar. kad nafak shabbatta, keroza kay bechol pitcha ufitcha, veamar (Tehillim 9:18) yashuvu reshaim lishola vegomer. ta chaze, nishmatin detzaddikayay, kudesha berich hu natir lon, dela yitmasserun bida deduma, dehu memanna, hada hu dichtiv, yishmar tzetcha uvoecha uchetiv yishmor et nafshecha.
474: Osri laggefen iro. may gefen, da keneset yisrael, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 80:9) gefen mimmitzrayim tassia. uchetiv, (Tehillim 128:3) eshtecha kegefen poriyya, eshtecha, kehay gefen kaddisha. amar ribbi yose, hay gefen dimvarchinan beh bore peri haggafen. bore, hayeynu dichtiv, etz ose peri. peri haggefen, da etz peri. ose peri, dechar, etz peri da nukeva. begine kach, bore peri haggefen da dechar venukeva kechada. (sefer acher nishmatehon detzaddikayyay inun peri haggefen kidamar bore peri haggefen).

Osri laggefen iro, da malka meshicha, dezammin leshalletaa al kol chele amamaya, chelin di memannan al ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, veinun tukefa dilhon leittakkefa, vezammin malka meshicha leitgabbera alayyhu.

Begin dehay gefen, shallit al kol illen kitrin tattain, deshalte behu amamaya ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, hay natzach leela. yisrael, deinun soreka, yeshetzun vinatzchun chelin ochoranin letatta, veal kullehu yitgabber malka meshicha. hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 9:9) ani verochev al chamor veal ayir. ayir vachamor teren kitrin inun, deshalte behu amamaya ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, veinun mistar semala sitra dechol.
Uma deamar ani, vechi malka meshicha ani ikre. ella hachi amar ribbi shimon, begin delet leh middileh vekarinan leh melech hammashiach. da hu sihara kaddisha leela, delet lah nehora ella mishshimsha.

Malka meshicha da, yishlot beshaltaneh, yityayched beducheteh, ucheden (Zecharya 9:9) hinne malkech yavo lach, setam. i letatta ani hu, deha besitra desihara hu. i leela ani, aspaklarya dela nahara. lechem oni. veim kol da, rochev al chamor veal ayir, tukefa deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, leikkafyay techoteh, veyittakkaf kudesha berich hu beducheteh.

Kibbes bayyayin levusho, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra, uchetiv pura darachti levaddi vegomer. kibbes bayyayin da setar gevura, dina kashya, lemehve al amamaya ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, uvedam anavim suto, da ilana letatta, be dina deikre anavim, veyena itmasar (sefer acher istammar) bedam anavim, begin leitlabbesha betarvavyeyhu, letavra techoteh kol shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot umalchin dealma.

Ribbi yose patach veamar. osri laggefen iro. uchetiv, (Bereshit 40:10) uvaggefen shelosha sarigim vehi keforachat alta nitztzah. ta chaze, kamma atimin inun beni nasha, dela yadin vela mashgichin bikara demarehon, vela mistakkele bemille deorayyta, vela yade archayyhu bemma yittafsun. dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:19) derech reshaim kaafela lo yadu bamme yikkashelu.

Bezimna kadmaa havat nevua sharya alayyhu divne nasha, vehavu yadin umistakkele leminda bikara illaa. kevan defaska nevua minnayyhu, havu mishtammeshe bevat kol. hasheta paska nevua ufaska bat kol, vela mishtammeshe bene nasha ella bechelma.

Vechelma darga tattaa hu levar, deha taninan chelma echad mishshishshim linvua. may tama, begin deatyay middarga shetitaa letatta, veha ittemar. ta chaze, chelma lecholla itchaze, begin dechelma mistar semala atyay, venachit bechamma dargin, veitchaze (192 amud bet) chelma, afillu lechayyayvaya. veafillu leovde kochavim umazzalot.

Begin dezimnin naktin chelma veshamin hanne zine bishin, umodin livne nasha, minnayyhu dechayychan (behu) bivni nasha, umodiin lon millin kedivin. ulezimnin millin dikshot deshamin. ulezimnin deinun sheluchin lechayyayvaya, umodae lon millin illain.

Hay rasha may ketiv beh, chama chelma dikshot, dichtiv uvaggefen shelosha sarigim. (192 amud alef) may gefen. da keneset yisrael, dichtiv, (Tehillim 80:15) habbet mishshamayim uree ufekod gefen zot. mishshamayim, deha meatar da itramme, kema deat amer, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim aretz. ufekod gefen zot, gefen dehi zot, vadday.

Shelosha sarigim, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 29:2) shelosha edre tzon rovtzim aleha. vehi keforachat, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo, deitnehir sihara. alta nitztzah, da yerushala 40 diltatta. davar acher, alta nitztzah, leela, hahu darga dekayyma ala veyannik lah, kema deat amer
475: (Bereshit 1:11) asher zaro vo al haaretz. hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim, lenatra behu yayin demintera.

Chame kamma chama hahu rasha. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 40:11) vechos paro beyadi vaekach et haanavim vaeschat otam. hacha chama hahu kos tarela, yannika deve dina, denafik meinun anavim deityeyhiv lefaro veshate leh, kema dehava beginehon deyisrael. kevan deshama yosef da, chade, veyada milla dikshot behay chelma. begini kach pashar leh chelma letav, al devassar leyosef behay.
Ta chaze, osri laggefen iro, deitkafyayn techot hay gefen kol inun chelin takkifin deammin ovde avoda zara, kidamaran, begin hay gefen, itkashshar veitkafyay hahu chela dilhon. veittemar.

Ribbi shimon amar, it gefen, veit gefen. it gefen kaddisha illaa, veit gefen deikre, (Devarim lak) gefen sedom, veit (Yirmeyahu 2:21) gefen nachriya bat el nechar. begin kach ketiv gefen zot, hahi deikre kulo zera emet. sorek ellu yisrael, denafke mehay gefen. kad chavu yisrael, veshavku lehay gefen, ma ketiv, ki miggefen sedom gafnam vegomer. uvegin kach it gefen veit gefen.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak havu azle bearcha. amar ribbi yehuda leribbi yitzchak, nezil behay chakal, dehu orach meshar yattir. azlu. ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv, (Mishlei 31:21) la tira levetah mishshaleg ki chol betah lavush shanim. hay kera, ribbi chizkiyya chavrana okim beh. deamar, dina dechayyayve degehinnom teresar yarchin, palga minayyhu bechamma ufalga minnayyhu betalga.

Beshata dealin lenura, inun amre da hu vadday gehinnom, alin letalga, amre da charifa desita (desitva) dekudesha berich hu. sharan veamrin va, ulevatar amrin vavy. vedavid amar (Tehillim 40:3) vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven vayyakem vegomer. meatar (59 amud alef) deamre va, ulevatar vavy.

Vehechan mishtalleme nafshayyhu, bashsheleg. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 68:15) befares shadday melachim bah tashleg betzalmon. yachol af yishrael ken, talmud lomar lo tira levetah mishshaleg. may tama. begin dechol betah lavush shanim. al tikre shanim ella shenayim. kegon mila uferia, tzitzit utefilin, mezuza vener chanukka kulei.

Ta chaze, lo tira levetah mishshaleg, da keneset yisrael, deihi kol betah lavush shanim, kema deamaran. dichtiv, chamutz begadim vegomer, levusha dedina kashya, leitpara meammin ovde avoda zara. vezammin kudesha berich hu lemilbash levusha sumeka, vecharba sumeka, uleitpara min sumeka. levusha sumeka, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) chamutz begadim, uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) maddua adom lilvushecha. seyayfa sumeka, dichtiv, (yeshaya la) cherev laAdonai mala dam. uleitpara min sumeka, dichtiv, (yeshaya la) ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra vegomer. tu, ki chol betah lavush shanim deha missitra dedina kashya ka atyay.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday hachi hu, ella kol betah lavush shanim, may shanim, illen shanim kadmoniyyot, begin deihi itkelilat mikkullehu, veyanka mikkol sitrin, kedichtiv, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam.

Ad dehavu azle, pagu beh behahu yenuka, dehava azil lekappotkiya bekastira dechamra, vechad sava rachiv. amar hahu sava lehahu yenuka, beri, ema li keraich. amar leh, keray lav chad hu, ella chut letatta, o erkav lekammach veema lach. amar leh, la baina. ana sava veant ravya, deatkal garmi bahadach. amar leh, i hachi ammay shealt keray. amar leh, begin denezil beorcha. amar, tippach rucheh dehahu sava, dehu rachiv vela yada milla, veamar dela yitkal bahadi. itperash mehahu sava, vaazil leh beorcha.

Kad matu ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak, kariv legabbayyhu. sheilu leh, vesach lon ovada, amar leh ribbi yehuda, shappir ka avadt. zil bahadan, venetiv hacha, venishma milla mippumach. amar lon, lae (sefer acher Rava) ana, dela
476: Achilna yoma den. afiku nahama, vihivu leh. itrechish lon nissa, veashkachu chad nevia demaya dakkik techot ilana, shate minnayyhu, veinun shatu vitivu.
Patach hahu yenuka veamar, (Tehillim 37:1) ledavid al titchar bamreim al tekanne beose avla. ledavid, i shirata, la kaamar. i tefilla, la kaamar. ella bechol atar ledavid setam, ruch hakkodesh amaro.

Al titchar bamreim. may al titchar bamreim, al titchabber mibbae leh. ella al taavid tacharut bamreim, begin dela yadat yesoda degarmach, vela techul leh, dilma ihu ilana dela itakkar lealmin, vetidche kammeh.

Veal tekanne beose avla, dela tashgach beovadehon, vela tete lekana alayyhu, dechol man dechame ovadehon, vela kanne lekudesha berich hu, aavar al telat lavin. dichtiv, (Shemot 20:4) lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay. lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna. lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna.

Vegin kach, bae leh lebar nash leitparsha minnayyhu, ulemiste orcheh minnayyhu, al da itperashna vesatina archay. mikkan ulehala deashkachna lechu, ema hanne kerae kammechon. patach veamar, vayyikra el moshe, hacha alef zeera. ammay, begin dehay keria la hava bishlimu. may tama, deha la hava ella bemishkena, uveara ochora. begin dishlimu la ishtakkach ella beara kaddisha.

Tu, hacha shechinta, (sefer acher 33 hatam ugeris nukeba) hatam shelimu didchar venukeva, (divrei hayamim 1 1:1) adam shet enosh. adam, shelimu dechar venukeva, hacha nukeva. tu sefa dikra, vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor, begin kach alef zeera.

Tu alef zeera, metal lemalka, dehava yativ becharseye, vechitra demalchuta aleh, ikre melech illaa. kad nachit veazal leve avdeh, melech zuta ikre. kach kudesha berich hu, kol zimna deihu leela al kolla, melech illaa ikre. kevan denachit madoreh letatta, melech ihu, aval lav illaa kekadmita, begin kach alef zeera.

Vayyikra, hachi taninan, zammin leh lehechaleh. meohel moed. man ohel moed. ohel deveh talyayn moed vechagga veshabbatta lemimne, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 1:14) vehayu leotot ulemoadim, beh sharya chushebna lemimne. uman ihu, sihara, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 33:20) ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach.

Lemor, may lemor. begin legallaa, (aval kolla chad veshappir hu, begin dishlimu vashepayrav hu atar legallaa) ma dehava satim lego. uvechol atar lemor, kema deat amer, vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor, deityeyhiv reshu legallaa. aval kolla chad hu, veshappir hu, begin deha itmanne lesihara hahi milla, meatar demoshe kayyma.

Vaydabber, leela. el moshe, beemtzaita. lemor, batrayyta. atar, deit reshu legallaa. tu, vayyikra el moshe ma ketiv leela, (Shemot 39:33) vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe vegomer. ammay el moshe. hachi amru, begin demoshe chama leh betura, vekudesha berich hu achme leh bechezu deena, kema deat amer, (Shemot 27:8) kaasher hera otcha bahar, uchetiv, (Bamidbar 8:4) kammare asher hera Adonai et moshe vegomer. uchetiv (Shemot 28) uree vaase betavnitam asher atta mare bahar, hasheta ayytiu leh, begin deyecheme, i ihu kehahu mishkena dechama.

Aval ammay vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe. ella, lemalka devaa lemivni palterin lematronita, pakkid leumanin hechala da beduch pelan, vehechala da beduch pelan, hacha atar learsa, vehacha atar lenayycha. kevan daavidu lon umanin, achmiyyu lemalka. kach vayyaviu et hammishkan el moshe, mare deveta, ish haelohim, kevan deishtachlal hechala, matronita zeminat lemalka lehechala, zeminat levaalah immah, begin kach vayyikra el moshe.
Uvegin demoshe mare deveta ihu, ma ketiv, (Shemot 33:7) umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane, moshe deihu mare deveta,
477: Avid hachi, ma delet reshu levar nash ochora lemebad hachi.

Vaydabber Adonai elav, darga ochora illaa, ucheden beshata deizdamman moshe lemeal, keden patach veamar, (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem. may adam hacha. ella kad itchabberu shimsha vesihara kechada, patach veamar adam. kedichtiv, (Chavakuk 3:11) shemmesh yareach amad zevulah, amad, velo amdu.

Ki yakriv mikkem, hacha itremiz, man deyaavid pulechana dekarbena shelim, deyishtakkach dechar venukeva. mashma dichtiv mikkem, deyishtakkach bechezu dilchon. karban laAdonai deakriv kolla, leitachada kechada, leela vetatta.

Min habbehema, leachazaa adam uvehema, kolla kechada. min habbakar umin hatztzon, illen retichin, deinun dachyayn. dechevan deamar min habbehema, yachol mikkolla, ben dachyayn ben mesaavan. hadar veamar, min habbakar umin hatztzon.

Takrivu et karbanchem. karbani mibbae leh, may karbanchem. ella bekadmita karban laAdonai, vehasheta karbanchem. karban laAdonai adam. karbanchem min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon, leachazaa yichuda mittatta leela, umeela letatta. mittatta leela, hayeynu karban laAdonai. meela letatta, hayeynu karbanchem.

Lemalka, deihu yativ betureska illaa, leela leela, vecharseya ittakkan al hahu tureska, umalka illaa al kolla. bar nash dekariv dorona lemalka, baa lesalka middarga ledarga, ad desalik mittatta leela leatar demalka yativ, illaa al kolla. ucheden yadin deha salkin dorona lemalka, vehahu dorona demalka ihu. nachit dorona meela letatta, ha yadin dehahu dorona demalka nachit meela, lirchima demalka deihu letatta.

Kacha bekadmita, adam salik bedargoy mittatta leela, ucheden karban laAdonai. min habbehema min habbakar, nachit bedargoy meela letatta, ucheden karbanchem. begine kach ketiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yaari im divshi shatiti yiyini im chalavi. hayeynu adam vekarban laAdonai. ichlu reim, hayeynu min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon, ucheden takrivu et karbanchem.

Atu ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda uneshakuhu al resheh. amru, berich rachamana dezakkena lemishma da, uverich rachamana, dela itavidu millin illen behahu sava. kamu veazlu. ad dehavu azle, chamu chad gefen netia bechag ginna.

Patach hahu yenuka veamar, osri laggefen iro velassoreka beni atono hay kera raza illaa hu. osri, asar mibbae leh. iro, ayir mibbae leh. ella raza hu, ledardeke deinun beve rav, leistammera mehahu gira deayir, ushema kaddisha itkelil tamman 15.

Uchema dehacha itremiz shema kaddisha, hachi name velassoreka, sorek mibbae leh. itkelil tamman 11. beni ben mibbae leh. sorek, kedichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) veanochi netatich sorek. ben, kema deat amer, (Zecharya 9) ben atonot. ammay soreka, veammay beni.

Ella, kema deit shema kaddisha leikkafya leayir, hachi name, it shema kaddisha, leikkafya chela ochora, deihi chamra, deilmale dishma kaddisha itremiz hacha, havu metarteshe alma, 15 bechela da, (sefer acher 21) 11 bechela da, leistammera alma minnayyhu, uleistammera bar nash, dela yishletun beh bealma.

Osri laggefen, may gefen. da keneset yisrael, ammay itkeriat gefen. ella ma gefen, la mekabbela alah netia ochora, hachi name keneset yisrael, la mekabbela alah ella lekudesha berich hu. uvegin keneset yisrael, itkafyayn kammah kol chelin ochoranin, vela yachlin leavasha uleshaltaa bealma. veal da attil kera shema kaddisha benayyhu, behay gisa uvehay gisa. beni atono, deitakkar begin hahu sorek, kema deat amer, veanochi netatich sorek vegomer.

Kibbes bayyayin levusho vegomer, kibbes, koves mibbae leh. ella kibbes, miyyoma deitbere alma, uman ihu, da malka meshicha. bayyayin setar semala. uvedam anavim setar semala. letatta. vezammin malka meshicha
478: Leshalletaa leela al kol chelin ochoranin deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, uletavra tokfehon meela umittatta.

Davar acher, kibbes bayyayin levusho, kegavvna dehay chamra, achaze chedu, vechuleh dina. (leammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot). hachi name malka meshicha, yechoziyi chedu leyisrael, vechuleh dina leammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. ketiv, (Bereshit 1:2) veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim, da rucha demalka meshicha, umin yoma deitbere alma, asche levusheh bechamra illaa.

Chame ma ketiv batreh, chachlili enayim miyyayin uleven shinnayim mechalav, da chamra illaa, (sefer acher dimravvi deorayyta) deorayyta demarve, minneh shate. uleven shinnayim mechalav, deha orayyta yayin vechalav, tora shebbichtav, vetora shebbeal pe.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 104:15) veyayin yesammach levav enosh (sefer acher amay, begin dameater dechedva kaate, uman hu sofeh dikra) lehatzehil panim mishshamen, vadday meatar deitkere shamen. ta chaze, sherata dechamra chedva, hu atar dechol chedu minneh nafka. vesofeh dina. may tama, begin desofa dileh, atar kenishu decholla, dina hu, uveh itdan alma. veal da sheruta chedva, vesofa dina. begine kach, lehatzehil panim mishshamen. meatar dechol chedva minneh nafka.

Velechem levav enosh yisad, man lechem. ella lechem alma said (samich), vei tema, deveh talyay seidu dealma bilchodoy, lav hachi, deha lelya bela yoma, la ishtakkach, vela bae leafrasha lon. uman deafrish lon, yitparash mechayyin, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Devarim 8:3) lemaan hodiacha ki lo al hallechem levaddo yichye haadam. begin dela bae leitparsha.
Vei tema, david hech kaamar velechem levav enosh yisad, hoil vela talyay beh bilchodoy seidu dealma. ella dayyka demilla, velechem, vav ittosaf, kemo vaAdonai, veal da, kolla ishtakkach kechada.

Ta chaze, man dimvarech al mezona, la yevarech al petora rekanya, uvae nahama leishtakkecha al patora, vechassa dechamra bimina. may tama, begin lekashra semala bimina, venahama deyitbarach minnayyhu, uleitkashshera behu, ulemehve kolla chad kishshura, levarcha shema kaddisha kedka yeut. deha lechem itkashshar beyayin, veyayin bimina, ucheden birchan sharyayn bealma, ufatora ishtelim kedka yeut.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ilmale la izdamman lan orcha da ella lemishma millin illen, day lan. amar ribbi yehuda, yaot hu lehay yenuka dela yinda kol hay, veana mistafina aleh. i yitkayyaym bealma begin hay. amar ribbi yitzchak velamma. amar leh, begin dehay ravya yachil leistakkela beatra delet reshu levar nash leistakkela beh. umistafina aloy, dead la yimte lefirkoy, yashgach veyistakkal veyaanshun leh.

Shama hahu yenuka. amar, la mistafina meonasha lealmin, deha beshata deistallik abba mealma, barich li vetzalle alay. vidana dizchuta deabba yagin alay. amru leh, uman hu avuch. amar, (nusach acher leta rav yehuda) bereh derav hamenuna sava, natlu leh, vearkevuha al kitfayyhu telat milin.
Karu aleh, (Shoftim 14:14) mehaochel yatza maachol umeaz yatza matok vegomer. amar lon hahu yenuka, milla ata lidayychu, parishu lah. amru leh, kudesha berich hu zammin lan archa dechayye, ema ant.

Patach veamar, mehaochel yatza maachol umeaz yatza matok. hay kera, asmachta it lan beh, mehaochel, da tzaddik, dichtiv, (Mishlei 13:25) tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho. tzaddik ochel vadday, venatil kolla, ammay, lesova nafsho. lemehav sava, lehahu atar deikre nafsho dedavid. yatza maachol, deilmale hahu tzaddik, la yippuk mezona lealmin, vela yachil alma lekayyma (beh). umeaz yatza matok, da yitzchak, devarich leyaakov betal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz.

Tu, af al gav decholla chad, ilmale tukefa dedina kashya, la nafka devash. man devash. da tora shebbeal pe, dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:11) umetukim middevash venofet tzufim. meaz, da tora shebbichtav, dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten. yatza matok, da tora shebbeal pe.
479: Azlu kechada telat yomin, ad dematu leturesa dekira deimmeh. kevan dechamat lon atkanit beta, veyatvu tamman telat yomin ochoranin. berchuhu, veazlu, vesidderu millin kammeh derabbi shimon. amar, vadday yerutat orayyta achsin, veilmale zechuta daavahan yitannash milleela, aval kudesha berich hu leinun deazlin batar orayyta, achsinu lah inun uvenayyhu lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 59:21) vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai ruchi asher alecha vegomer.

Zevulun lechof yammim yishkon vehu lechof oniyyot veyarchato vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 45:4) chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha. vechi da hod vehadar, lemezan zayyna, uleizdarza behay. man deishtaddal beorayyta, veaggach kerava beorayyta, vezariz garmeh bah, da hu shevacha (demareh), da hu hod vehadar, veat amart chagor charbecha.

Ella, vaday ikkera demilla, at kayyayma kaddisha. yahav kudesha berich hu, verashim leh bivni nasha, begin deyinterun leh, vela yifgemun leh bifgimu lehay reshima demalka. uman defagim leh, ha kaim lekovleh (Vayikra 26:25) cherev nokemet nekam berit, lenakma nukema divrit kaddisha, deitreshim beh, vehu pagim leh.

Uman devae lenatra hay atar, yizdarez vitakken garmeh, vishavve lekovleh, beshata deyitzra visha yitkaf aloy, lehay cherev dekayyma al yarech, leitpara mimman defagim hay atar. ucheden, chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor, gibbor ihu, gibbor itkere. veal da hodcha vahadarecha.

Davar acher, chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor. man denafik bearcha, yetakken garmeh bitzlota demareh, veyizdarez behay (49 amud bet) tzedek, cherev illaa, bitzlota uvautin ad la yippuk learcha. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 85:14) tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav. ta chaze, zevulun nafik tedira lishvilin vearchin, veaggach keravin, veizdarez behay cherev illaa, bitzlota uvautin, ad la nafik bearcha, ucheden natzach ammin, veittakkaf alayyhu. vei tema yehuda, ha ittakkan behay, leaggacha keravin, vetikkunin, behay cherv, ammay zevulun. ella.

Ta chaze, hanne teresar shivtin, kullehu tikkuna dematronita havu. teren tikkunin denukeve amar shelomo beshir hashshirim, chad leraaya illaa yovela, vechad lechalla, shenat hashshemita. chad tikkuna leela, vechad tikkuna letatta. ovada divreshit, hachi hu name, behanne tere atre, chad ovada leela, vechad ovada letatta, veal da peticha deorayyta bev. ovada diltatta, kegavvna dilela, da avad alma illaa, veda avad alma tattaa. kegavvna da.
Teren tikkunin denukeve kaamar shelomo, chad leela, vechad letatta. chad leela, betikkuna illaa dishma kaddisha. chad letatta, betikkuna tattaa kegavvna dilela.

Ta chaze, zakkaa chulakeh deyaakov kaddisha, dezacha lehay. veha ittemar, miyyoma deitbere alma, la ishtakkach arsa shelemata kearseh deyaakov. uveshata devaa leistallaka mealma, keden hava shelim, bechol (231 amud bet) sitroy. avraham mimineh, yitzchak mismaleh, hu beemtzaita, shechinta kammeh. kevan dechama yaakov hay, kara livnoy, veamar lon heasfu, begin deyishtakkach tikkuna dilela vetatta.

Ta chaze, raza demilla, teren tikkunin ishtakkachu tamman, chad illaa, vechad tattaa, lemeheve kolla shelim kedka yeut. tikkuna illaa, tikkuna satim vegalya, deha tikkuna deyovela ihu, hahu deamar shelomo beshir hashshirim kidkaamaran, resha satim hava dela itgalleyay hacha, vela yaot leitgalleyay. deroin vegufa itgalleyayn, veha yediin. shokin setimu vela itgalleyayn. may tama, begin dinvua la sharya ella beara kaddisha. vetikkuna da satim vegalyay.
Tikkuna ochora tattaa, tikkuna dechalla dekaamar shelomo beshir hashshirim, hay tikkuna deitgalleyay yattir, vetikkuna da bitresar shivtin
